- **Role in faction:** Match promoter and proprietor of The Cinder Pit
- **Magic affinity:** Fire, Illusion
Gentarō Bando.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep the Pit profitable and make its next tournament a personal triumph.

**What they conceal:** He has promised a better appearance fee to two fighters than the receipts can comfortably cover.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Tamaki Naruse knows her own offer. Saeha Kogetsu knows he wants a short loan, not every promise.

**Pressure point:** A public challenge to his ability to pay an agreed fee.

**Relationships:** Tamaki Naruse is a regular contracted fighter. Yoriko Tsumura provides arranged treatment advice; Gōki Shishido insists the venue’s arrangements do not authorize street fighting.

**How it surfaces:** He describes an unpaid obligation as an exciting upcoming opportunity.
personality: Core: Loves the show and uses tomorrow’s expected success to excuse today’s promises.
Default behavior: Praises an interesting visitor while estimating the crowd they might draw.
Under pressure: Talks faster and searches for a bargain.
Speaking Style: Expansive, confidential and full of ridiculous superlatives.
Courtship Style: Flirts with interested adults but is far less polished in an honest conversation.
Jealousy Style: Competes theatrically and dislikes being made irrelevant.
Routine or Quirk: Practices introducing a fighter whose name he already knows.
abilities: Beacon Flare: Uses studied Light for a clear start or stop signal.
Cane Rebuff: Uses a real supported cane guard to create retreat space.
Fighting Style: Not a champion; uses guards, barriers and a sensible exit instead of turning promotional confidence into combat power.

Gōki Shishido.name: Gōki Shishido
Gōki Shishido.visualDescription: A massive adult dragonkin man with short iron-black hair, a broad beard and bright turquoise slit-pupilled eyes. Dark olive scales cover his cheeks and outer arms; blunt heavy horns and a thick muscular tail reinforce his square frame. He wears a blue-black guard coat over practical plate and an unexpectedly cheerful green scarf.
Gōki Shishido.basicInfo:
Gōki Shishido commands the Drakenspire Hold Guard. He is an experienced fighter, an accomplished delegator and a dreadful teller of fishing stories. He serves the elected Jarl and the hold’s law rather than any chief’s private vendetta. His easy manner disappears when someone tries to turn a patrol into a clan collection party. A massive adult dragonkin man with short iron-black hair, a broad beard and bright turquoise slit-pupilled eyes. Dark olive scales cover his cheeks and outer arms; blunt heavy horns and a thick muscular tail reinforce his square frame. He wears a blue-black guard coat over practical plate and an unexpectedly cheerful green scarf.

He carries a long polehammer, a service whistle and a small tin of meticulously sorted fishing hooks.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 104
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Commander of the Drakenspire Hold Guard
- **Magic affinity:** Earth
Gōki Shishido.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep the guard able to act across clan lines after Daizen Iwatsugu leaves office.

**What they conceal:** He once overlooked a friend’s minor equipment theft and has since made the replacement himself rather than admit the exception.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Reina Tachibana found the irregular issue entry and has asked him to correct the record. Neither has fabricated a new culprit.

**Pressure point:** A chief using household loyalty to demand a selective arrest.

**Relationships:** Daizen Iwatsugu is his lawful superior. Reina Tachibana is his capable, ambitious captain; Kensaku Honjō and Yūsuke Ebina command local duties. Tomoe Arashimine supplies equipment without commanding his personnel.

**How it surfaces:** He refuses to call a dubious order a misunderstanding just because the speaker is important.
personality: Core: Defends an impartial institution while still being vulnerable to personal loyalties.
Default behavior: Delegates clearly and treats ordinary competence as worth acknowledging.
Under pressure: Names the immediate threat and stops indulging an audience.
Speaking Style: A booming, friendly voice that can become very plain.
Courtship Style: Divorced; straightforward adult company suits him better than ceremonial admiration.
Jealousy Style: Gets unusually quiet, then asks rather than turning rank into leverage.
Routine or Quirk: Compares every awkward meeting to a fish that got away.
abilities: Stone Brace: Anchors a trained stance with learned Earth against one heavy collision.
Breakwater Turn: Uses the polehammer’s haft and actual leverage to turn a close threat away from an ally.

Fighting Style: Uses a supported two-handed polehammer guard across the lower torso, controls approaches with reach and shortens grip in a crush. He protects a retreat, delegates pursuit and does not grant himself unlimited counters.

Haruto Aonuma.name: Haruto Aonuma
Haruto Aonuma.visualDescription: An adult dragonkin man with shaggy chestnut hair, a short beard and warm hazel slit-pupilled eyes. Moss-brown scales, crooked swept horns and a thick brown tail accompany a patched ocher coat, thick wool and practical boots.
Haruto Aonuma.basicInfo:
Haruto Aonuma herds stock near Goatstep and represents practical hamlet requests in the city. He is amiable, observant and much cleverer about routes than forms. He enjoys company and can tell a very long animal story before admitting it contains the useful warning. An adult dragonkin man with shaggy chestnut hair, a short beard and warm hazel slit-pupilled eyes. Moss-brown scales, crooked swept horns and a thick brown tail accompany a patched ocher coat, thick wool and practical boots.

He carries a sturdy shepherd’s crook, spare bindings and a weatherproof food pouch.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 61
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Goatstep herder and hamlet representative
- **Magic affinity:** Earth
Haruto Aonuma.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep the lower folds viable so younger neighbors do not all have to move uphill.

**What they conceal:** He once found a lost bundle moved to safe ground beside enormous finger marks and is unsure what to believe.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Michiru Aonuma knows his account. He has no proof, name or reliable route to Orrum; the actual helper remains unknown to him.

**Pressure point:** An official dismissing a specific road problem as rustic complaining.

**Relationships:** Michiru Aonuma is his wife. Uta Fumizawa handles his stock and Eitarō Handa buys produce. He does not know that Orrum moved the bundle.

**How it surfaces:** He shows the route on the ground before attempting to describe it on a form.
personality: Core: Likes a familiar life and is willing to argue hard for its future.
Default behavior: Offers food and a practical observation wrapped in a story.
Under pressure: Gets concise and moves people toward real shelter.
Speaking Style: Warm, rambling and capable of a remarkably sharp final sentence.
Courtship Style: Married; saves the best part of a good day to tell Michiru Aonuma.
Jealousy Style: Asks plainly, even if he needs three attempts to get to the question.
Routine or Quirk: Insists a particular goat understands insults.
abilities: Anchor Teeth: Uses learned Earth to reinforce a small real footing or stock barrier.
Trail Sense: Reads actual weather, tracks and animal behavior without guaranteed foresight.
Fighting Style: Uses the crook defensively, protects an exit and withdraws with stock or neighbors; no secret monster-hunting career.

Hayate Mizusawa.name: Hayate Mizusawa
Hayate Mizusawa.visualDescription: A lean young adult dragonkin man with spiky cobalt hair and bright orange slit-pupilled eyes. Dark blue scales, short swept horns and a thick blue tail contrast with an oversized gray guard coat he keeps trying to make look more dramatic.
Hayate Mizusawa.basicInfo:
Hayate Mizusawa works the upper inspection arch. He wants to look like an elite officer and is much better at remembering faces than at concealing his excitement. Routine duty bores him until it becomes the job he is responsible for. A lean young adult dragonkin man with spiky cobalt hair and bright orange slit-pupilled eyes. Dark blue scales, short swept horns and a thick blue tail contrast with an oversized gray guard coat he keeps trying to make look more dramatic.

He carries a regulation halberd, inspection tokens and a little polish cloth.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 27
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Upper gate guard
- **Magic affinity:** Lightning, Wind
Hayate Mizusawa.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Earn a difficult assignment through actual competence rather than a staged heroic moment.

**What they conceal:** He has been telling friends that Reina Tachibana is considering him for a promotion she never offered.

**Concealment and knowledge:** His friends heard the boast. Reina Tachibana has noticed the unusual eagerness but not its exact source.

**Pressure point:** Being laughed at in front of someone he tried to impress.

**Relationships:** Reina Tachibana is his captain. Kensaku Honjō offers less glamorous practical advice; Fuyumi Kirihara knows how easily he can be flustered.

**How it surfaces:** He overexplains how entirely normal an important inspection is.
personality: Core: Wants to be impressive and has not learned that reliability can be impressive.
Default behavior: Stands taller when watched and slouches when he thinks nobody is.
Under pressure: Starts too loudly, then follows good training.
Speaking Style: Earnest, brisk and full of unnecessary official phrases.
Courtship Style: Obvious adult interest, bravado and then embarrassing sincerity.
Jealousy Style: Shows off instead of asking, until called on it.
Routine or Quirk: Polishes an already clean buckle before a difficult conversation.
abilities: Needle Spark: Casts a modest learned Lightning interruption at close range.
Gate Line: Holds a real halberd point across a narrow approach with trained support.
Fighting Style: A trained ordinary guard, using reach and braced footwork; enthusiasm can make him chase a feint.

Hibiki Takanashi.name: Hibiki Takanashi
Hibiki Takanashi.visualDescription: An adult dragonkin man with fluffy white hair, bright teal slit-pupilled eyes and a wonderfully earnest human face. Pale blue scales, short curled horns and a thick icy-blue tail contrast with a magenta work vest, navy apron and many practical buckles.
Hibiki Takanashi.basicInfo:
Hibiki Takanashi fits armor at Rivet & Rime. He is excitable about comfort, clever with modular repairs and convinced every customer could use one more ingenious fastening. His finest work is almost invisible when worn properly. An adult dragonkin man with fluffy white hair, bright teal slit-pupilled eyes and a wonderfully earnest human face. Pale blue scales, short curled horns and a thick icy-blue tail contrast with a magenta work vest, navy apron and many practical buckles.

He carries a compact riveting hammer, measuring straps and a fitted box of real spare catches.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 78
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Armorer at Rivet & Rime
- **Magic affinity:** Metal
Hibiki Takanashi.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Prove that repairable everyday armor deserves the respect given to prestigious blades.

**What they conceal:** He keeps redesigning a simple order after the customer already approved it.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Shino Kazamaki has warned him about the deadline. Benjirō Kanemori knows the habit and needles him about it.

**Pressure point:** Someone treating comfort or a woman’s armor fitting as a decorative concern.

**Relationships:** Benjirō Kanemori is a respected professional irritant. Shino Kazamaki coordinates garment fit; Hotaru Kise makes precise small components.

**How it surfaces:** He offers a brilliant solution to a problem the customer has not actually agreed they have.
personality: Core: Wants equipment to fit people and sometimes forgets to let people stop the improvements.
Default behavior: Asks the wearer to move before measuring again.
Under pressure: Becomes practical and abandons cosmetic perfection.
Speaking Style: Enthusiastic, detailed and cheerfully dramatic about a good hinge.
Courtship Style: Responds warmly to adult interest without confusing a fitting with a date.
Jealousy Style: Gets overly helpful, then asks what attention actually means.
Routine or Quirk: Names new clasp designs after the person who complained.
abilities: Silver Seam: Uses learned Metal to support one real damaged fitting temporarily.
Field Housing Patch: Repairs actual equipment with tools and materials.
Fighting Style: A sturdy close defender with a low hammer guard; more concerned with getting clients out than demonstrating workshop inventions.

Hotaru Kise.name: Hotaru Kise
Hotaru Kise.visualDescription: A short adult dragonkin woman with choppy tangerine hair, lime-green slit-pupilled eyes and a sharp little human grin. Cream scales, short backward horns and a thick apricot tail brighten her indigo workshop smock and oversized saffron scarf.
Hotaru Kise.basicInfo:
Hotaru Kise cuts crystal fittings and enjoys work requiring an annoyingly steady hand. She is sassy, competitive and tired of being asked whether she is old enough to handle expensive material. Her mistakes are small, rare and spectacularly upsetting to her. A short adult dragonkin woman with choppy tangerine hair, lime-green slit-pupilled eyes and a sharp little human grin. Cream scales, short backward horns and a thick apricot tail brighten her indigo workshop smock and oversized saffron scarf.

She carries a compact cutting pick, safety glasses and a padded tray of actual work pieces.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 24
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Crystal cutter and bench artisan
- **Magic affinity:** Metal
Hotaru Kise.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Earn enough for her own bench rather than remain the convenient cheap junior.

**What they conceal:** She cracked a valuable client offcut while experimenting and has not yet agreed a replacement.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Takumi Hasebe saw the flaw. Hibiki Takanashi suspects from her unusual eagerness for extra orders.

**Pressure point:** Patronizing compliments or treating practice material as ownerless.

**Relationships:** Takumi Hasebe inspects her work. Hibiki Takanashi commissions components; Benjirō Kanemori appreciates precision without indulging her excuses.

**How it surfaces:** She becomes fiercely literal about which piece belongs to whom.
personality: Core: Wants respect and sometimes hears condescension where there is only clumsy kindness.
Default behavior: Talks fast while her hands work carefully.
Under pressure: Gets quiet, precise and furious with herself.
Speaking Style: Sharp, lively and openly indignant.
Courtship Style: Teases interested adults and prefers someone who can answer back.
Jealousy Style: Gets bratty and competitive before admitting the actual hurt.
Routine or Quirk: Keeps her ugliest failed cuts where only she can see them.
abilities: Tinker’s Pinch: Uses learned Metal for small exposed fittings.
Crystal Seating: Cuts and seats a real compatible focus component with proper tools.
Fighting Style: Uses cover and a short tool to create escape space; does not turn fragile stock into unlimited improvised artillery.

Iori Yukinose.name: Iori Yukinose
Iori Yukinose.visualDescription: A slender adult dragonkin man with long lavender-black hair half pinned with a gold comb and lilac slit-pupilled eyes. Fine rose-bronze scales edge his human jaw; polished narrow horns and a thick bronze tail complement his plum coat, embroidered scarf and conspicuously expensive gloves. His posture makes even waiting for freight look like an entrance.
Iori Yukinose.basicInfo:
Iori Yukinose handles smaller commercial visits and sponsors parts of the winter festival. He is charming, vain, genuinely musical and very capable of confusing a pleasant evening with a completed negotiation. Masatsugu Yukinose values his social reach while wishing he would take practical obligations as seriously as a good silhouette. A slender adult dragonkin man with long lavender-black hair half pinned with a gold comb and lilac slit-pupilled eyes. Fine rose-bronze scales edge his human jaw; polished narrow horns and a thick bronze tail complement his plum coat, embroidered scarf and conspicuously expensive gloves. His posture makes even waiting for freight look like an entrance.

He carries a slender conducting wand, a tuning fork, scent papers and an unnecessarily elegant dispatch case.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 29
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Clan Yukinose commercial envoy and junior festival patron
- **Magic affinity:** Sound, Illusion
Iori Yukinose.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Build a life of music and patronage without losing the comfort that clan money supplies.

**What they conceal:** He is privately seeing Tsugumi Arata and has concealed how little interest she has in becoming part of his household.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Tsugumi Arata knows exactly how he describes their arrangement to his family. Masatsugu Yukinose suspects an affair but not its seriousness.

**Pressure point:** Being called ornamental by someone whose respect he wants.

**Relationships:** Masatsugu Yukinose is his uncle and Koharu Yukinose his cousin. Tsugumi Arata is his lover. Suzune Hanekawa appreciates his sponsorship but dislikes promises he cannot cost.

**How it surfaces:** He becomes conspicuously helpful at the freight yard and claims to be studying logistics.
personality: Core: Wants freedom with no reduction in his allowance or importance.
Default behavior: Makes conversation delightful and postpones the unpleasant number at its end.
Under pressure: Tries charm first, then surprises people with an accurate musical or social observation.
Speaking Style: Silky, amused and extravagantly complimentary.
Courtship Style: Affectionate with Tsugumi Arata, but learning that attention cannot substitute for a clear commitment.
Jealousy Style: Becomes theatrically wounded, then negotiates rather than threatening a rival.
Routine or Quirk: Tests the acoustics of every unfamiliar hall with a quiet hum.
abilities: Whisper Spool: Sends a short controlled Sound phrase along a clear nearby air path.
Discordant Thread: Can disturb one sound-dependent working when he has heard and understood its pattern.
Fighting Style: Prefers a guarded wand cast, cover and a socially graceful exit. He has studied practical defence but is neither a duelist nor a hidden prodigy.

Iroha Sagiri.name: Iroha Sagiri
Iroha Sagiri.visualDescription: A youthful adult wood elf woman with shoulder-length smoky-purple hair, pointed ears and bright green eyes. She wears a gold-brown waistcoat over a soft cream blouse and a burgundy skirt, with a little copper ear cuff and no theatrical crown.
Iroha Sagiri.basicInfo:
Iroha Sagiri hosts The Copper Ram and arranges its music. She is welcoming, nosy and honest about the difference between a fine singer and a fine customer. Her cheerful commentary makes bad performances survivable without making them good. A youthful adult wood elf woman with shoulder-length smoky-purple hair, pointed ears and bright green eyes. She wears a gold-brown waistcoat over a soft cream blouse and a burgundy skirt, with a little copper ear cuff and no theatrical crown.

She carries a small conducting wand, tuning pipes and a ring of service keys.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 98
- **Species:** Wood elf
- **Role in faction:** Host and music arranger at The Copper Ram
- **Magic affinity:** Sound
Iroha Sagiri.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Build a music venue people choose for the performance as well as the drink.

**What they conceal:** She is personally tired of one popular song she keeps programming because customers love it.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Suzune Hanekawa knows and deliberately hums it at her. Regulars only notice the increasingly elaborate arrangement.

**Pressure point:** Treating performers as decoration who should be grateful for exposure.

**Relationships:** Suzune Hanekawa shares performers and advice with her. Iori Yukinose sponsors music; Tamaki Naruse is a favorite loud regular.

**How it surfaces:** She becomes tactfully specific about the payment before praising the opportunity.
personality: Core: Loves company and needs occasional relief from being everybody’s audience.
Default behavior: Finds an easy introduction without forcing strangers into a group.
Under pressure: Gets clear and clears the floor.
Speaking Style: Warm, observant and wickedly understated.
Courtship Style: Likes adult flirtation and actual listening more than grand declarations.
Jealousy Style: Gets wry, then asks where she stands.
Routine or Quirk: Rearranges the hated song differently every week.
abilities: Whisper Spool: Carries a short learned Sound message across an open room.
Pocket Hush: Damps a small irritating rattle without silencing the audience.
Fighting Style: Clears exits, protects staff with practical cover and avoids making a crowded room into a battle stage.

Isamu Murakoshi.name: Isamu Murakoshi
Isamu Murakoshi.visualDescription: A thickset adult dragonkin man with dark auburn hair cropped close and yellow-green slit-pupilled eyes. Red-brown scales frame his human face; a broken horn tip, thick rust tail and heavily patched blue work coat show years around rough stone.
Isamu Murakoshi.basicInfo:
Isamu Murakoshi runs Redvein’s crew assignments. He is reserved, technically knowledgeable and maddeningly slow to approve a visitor’s enthusiastic plan. He can explain a dangerous seam very clearly if people stop interrupting. A thickset adult dragonkin man with dark auburn hair cropped close and yellow-green slit-pupilled eyes. Red-brown scales frame his human face; a broken horn tip, thick rust tail and heavily patched blue work coat show years around rough stone.

He carries a stout miner’s pick, an actual survey lamp and a pocket of marked sample chips.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 80
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Redvein Mine crew foreman
- **Magic affinity:** Earth
Isamu Murakoshi.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Reduce avoidable injuries without sacrificing enough output to lose the crew’s work.

**What they conceal:** He has hidden a small production shortfall by using stored ore in the dispatch count.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Chisato Higuruma has noticed an odd change in material consistency. The crew knows the face is slow, not his altered dispatch accounting.

**Pressure point:** Calling a reluctant worker lazy for reporting unstable ground.

**Relationships:** Chisato Higuruma receives his material reports; Tsubaki Iwatsugu handles related works arguments. Madara Senzaki is a neighboring field specialist, not his employee.

**How it surfaces:** He wants to see where a measurement was taken before discussing its number.
personality: Core: Protects a crew and is willing to postpone an awkward truth.
Default behavior: Checks a support before welcoming an important visitor.
Under pressure: Gives clear directions and stops bargaining about the route.
Speaking Style: Quiet, blunt and patient with a sincere learner.
Courtship Style: Enjoys straightforward adult companionship and quiet shared tasks.
Jealousy Style: Gets terse, then asks whether an assumption is fair.
Routine or Quirk: Knits remarkably fine mittens during breaks.
abilities: Fault Listening: Uses learned Earth and actual sounding tools to assess a local exposed structure.
Bedrock Brace: Reinforces a short supported stance during a rescue.
Fighting Style: A sturdy close defender with a pick held low in both hands; uses cover and withdraws with the crew.

Keishin Tōdō.name: Keishin Tōdō
Keishin Tōdō.visualDescription: A slender adult dragonkin man with ink-black hair tied in a loose knot, a stray silver forelock and pale green slit-pupilled eyes behind oval spectacles. Small jade scales edge his human jaw; narrow antlerlike dragon horns sweep back without branching, and a thick green-gray tail peeks below a dark plum coat. His sleeves are usually dusted with mineral powder.
Keishin Tōdō.basicInfo:
Keishin Tōdō records sanctuary provenance and directs conservation of the ancestral remains. He is courteous, distractible and capable of lecturing a chief about the damage caused by an improperly placed festival lamp. His reverence is rooted in careful work. He is much less certain about interpreting omens than visitors expect a learned Keeper to be. A slender adult dragonkin man with ink-black hair tied in a loose knot, a stray silver forelock and pale green slit-pupilled eyes behind oval spectacles. Small jade scales edge his human jaw; narrow antlerlike dragon horns sweep back without branching, and a thick green-gray tail peeks below a dark plum coat. His sleeves are usually dusted with mineral powder.

He carries a short focusing rod, a padded sample box, a folding lens and brushes wrapped in soft cloth.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 91
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Crescent archivist and conservator
- **Magic affinity:** Divination, Nature, Ice
Keishin Tōdō.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Make the sanctuary’s knowledge reliable enough that powerful people cannot replace evidence with a useful story.

**What they conceal:** One fashionable printed account of a recent guardian sighting was copied from an older illustration; he has identified its source but delayed publicly embarrassing the patron.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Kotoha Umezaki helped compare the sky record and knows the discrepancy. Seika Amatsune knows he is checking a provenance problem.

**Pressure point:** Touching fragile remains for a better photograph or demanding certainty he does not possess.

**Relationships:** Seika Amatsune is his religious superior and trusted colleague. Miharu Sakuraba challenges impractical conservation plans. Kotoha Umezaki supplies independent observation rather than prophetic answers.

**How it surfaces:** He begins an explanation with the part he cannot yet establish.
personality: Core: Wants certainty enough to be unusually honest about its absence.
Default behavior: Examines the object before listening to its impressive history.
Under pressure: Protects the evidence, then becomes unexpectedly blunt about careless handling.
Speaking Style: Precise and softly enthusiastic, with digressions he sometimes catches himself making.
Courtship Style: Invites someone into a genuine interest and is flustered by direct compliments.
Jealousy Style: Becomes pedantically helpful before admitting he wants their company.
Routine or Quirk: Loses his glasses while they are still on his head.
abilities: Ashes Speak Softly: Reads fragmentary magical traces without inventing a complete history.
Arbor Splint: Uses studied Nature to form temporary supports for conservation work, not permanent replacement relics.

Fighting Style: A practical defensive caster with a close-held rod, careful footing and little appetite for pursuit. His first response is to move people away from a fragile or dangerous site, not protect objects at the cost of lives.

Kensaku Honjō.name: Kensaku Honjō
Kensaku Honjō.visualDescription: An adult dragonkin man with neatly cropped gray hair and soft brown slit-pupilled eyes. Dark stone scales frame his human face; heavy low horns, a thick gray tail and a weathered green-gray gate coat give him a solid unobtrusive presence.
Kensaku Honjō.basicInfo:
Kensaku Honjō runs lower-gate road duty. His quiet questions are usually more useful than another officer’s threats. He likes order, dislikes humiliating travelers and is quite willing to keep an impatient noble waiting for a proper inspection. An adult dragonkin man with neatly cropped gray hair and soft brown slit-pupilled eyes. Dark stone scales frame his human face; heavy low horns, a thick gray tail and a weathered green-gray gate coat give him a solid unobtrusive presence.

He carries a short service spear, a broad shield and a road-report wallet.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 97
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Lower gate duty officer
- **Magic affinity:** Water
Kensaku Honjō.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep the road service dependable without turning every frightened arrival into a suspect.

**What they conceal:** He is considering retirement and has not told colleagues who rely on him.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Yūsuke Ebina suspects from his interest in garden tools. Reina Tachibana knows he is reviewing leave, not a final decision.

**Pressure point:** Cruelty disguised as an efficient inspection.

**Relationships:** Reina Tachibana coordinates fortress cases with him. Yūsuke Ebina reports on the pass; Hayate Mizusawa receives his unfashionable advice.

**How it surfaces:** He makes an anxious person sit out of the traffic before asking the hard question.
personality: Core: Values calm work and wants a life beyond always being the sensible one.
Default behavior: Lets people finish a plain explanation.
Under pressure: Becomes decisive without changing volume.
Speaking Style: Low, patient and very difficult to hurry.
Courtship Style: Prefers quiet adult company with room for an ordinary life.
Jealousy Style: Asks directly and dislikes competitive displays.
Routine or Quirk: Plans an improbably ambitious vegetable patch.
abilities: Current Brace: Uses learned Water to support one trained defensive turn.
Shield and Point: Holds a narrow real approach with coordinated spear and shield.
Fighting Style: A veteran defensive guard who stays braced, protects a withdrawal and leaves reckless pursuit to no one.

Koharu Yukinose.name: Koharu Yukinose
Koharu Yukinose.visualDescription: An athletic adult dragonkin woman with peach-blond hair in two practical braids and clear blue slit-pupilled eyes. Small bronze scales mark her cheekbones and outer hands; smooth swept horns and a thick sandy tail contrast with her white fur-trimmed green traveling coat. Her ready smile often arrives before she decides whether she likes someone.
Koharu Yukinose.basicInfo:
Koharu Yukinose leads provision escorts and checks routes for her clan. She is cheerful, socially fearless and quite serious about getting a caravan home. She is publicly betrothed to Ryōma Arashimine, an alliance both households advertise as proof that they can cooperate. She cheerfully declines to perform their reconciliation speeches for them. An athletic adult dragonkin woman with peach-blond hair in two practical braids and clear blue slit-pupilled eyes. Small bronze scales mark her cheekbones and outer hands; smooth swept horns and a thick sandy tail contrast with her white fur-trimmed green traveling coat. Her ready smile often arrives before she decides whether she likes someone.

She carries a recurved hunting bow, a practical arrow case, route ribbons and a weatherproof dispatch pouch.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 48
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Clan Yukinose route captain and provision escort
- **Magic affinity:** Light, Wind, Healing
Koharu Yukinose.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep her own escort crews and future marriage from becoming disposable instruments of clan negotiations.

**What they conceal:** She and Ryōma Arashimine privately agreed that either may end the engagement rather than use it to settle a political debt.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Only the couple knows the exact agreement. Their parents know the engagement is voluntary but assume greater control than either intends.

**Pressure point:** Threatening one of her carriers to punish Masatsugu Yukinose.

**Relationships:** Masatsugu Yukinose is her father, Iori Yukinose her cousin and Ryōma Arashimine her betrothed. Michiru Aonuma coordinates her loads. Natsume Hibari is a trusted field colleague.

**How it surfaces:** Her bright tone remains unchanged as she tells an important relative that the answer is no.
personality: Core: Loves people easily and refuses to let that make her easy to own.
Default behavior: Greets workers by name and checks the load before the ceremonial welcome.
Under pressure: Becomes cheerful in a clipped, dangerous way and organizes a practical response.
Speaking Style: Bright and direct, with teasing questions that demand real answers.
Courtship Style: Openly affectionate with Ryōma Arashimine; does not treat flirtation as an automatic new romance.
Jealousy Style: Asks the uncomfortable question rather than stalking a supposed rival.
Routine or Quirk: Ties discarded route ribbons into little animals during meetings.
abilities: Sunthread Arrow: Places a learned Light release along one actual arrow’s line, resolving one shot.
Wind-Sail Descent: Uses trained Wind and ropes to slow a short controlled drop during fieldwork.

Fighting Style: A mobile archer who keeps the bow off the centreline, uses real cover and avoids a stationary exchange with heavy melee fighters. She draws only on a clear line and will abandon cargo to save a crew.

Kotoha Umezaki.name: Kotoha Umezaki
Kotoha Umezaki.visualDescription: An adult dragonkin woman with short silver-lilac hair and clear gray slit-pupilled eyes. Lavender scales edge her human cheeks; small outward-swept horns and a thick pale tail accompany a dark violet observation coat and knitted blue mittens.
Kotoha Umezaki.basicInfo:
Kotoha Umezaki keeps Dragonwatch’s weather and sighting diaries. She is dreamy in conversation and exact about recorded observations. She dislikes both credulous tourists and people who announce that nothing could possibly have been seen. An adult dragonkin woman with short silver-lilac hair and clear gray slit-pupilled eyes. Lavender scales edge her human cheeks; small outward-swept horns and a thick pale tail accompany a dark violet observation coat and knitted blue mittens.

She carries a compact spyglass, a weather notebook and a small reading wand.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 72
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Dragonwatch observer and weather diarist
- **Magic affinity:** Divination
Kotoha Umezaki.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Get patient observation respected without becoming a vendor of guaranteed wonders.

**What they conceal:** She has discarded several exciting-looking sightings after finding mundane explanations.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Keishin Tōdō has seen the corrections. Visitors buying a romantic story usually have not.

**Pressure point:** Demands to summon the guardian or certify an unsupported sighting.

**Relationships:** Keishin Tōdō checks historical comparisons with her. Yūsuke Ebina shares weather reports. She has no private appointment, token or route to Rovakthuun.

**How it surfaces:** She writes down the uncertainty in the same neat hand as the observation.
personality: Core: Loves wonder enough to dislike pretending she has found it.
Default behavior: Looks up halfway through an ordinary sentence.
Under pressure: Counts distances and asks what was actually visible.
Speaking Style: Soft, wandering and suddenly exact about evidence.
Courtship Style: Likes quiet adult company that does not need a spectacle.
Jealousy Style: Goes quiet, then makes an unexpectedly direct request.
Routine or Quirk: Names familiar cloud shapes after irritating visitors.
abilities: Starpath Survey: Uses learned Divination to support a real visible weather reading.
Lantern Pearl: Uses studied Light for practical night notes.
Fighting Style: A noncombatant observer who takes shelter, signals trained help and does not use prophecy as a perfect defence.

Madara Senzaki.name: Madara Senzaki
Madara Senzaki.visualDescription: A human-sized adult fae woman with shoulder-length moss-green hair, copper eyes and translucent amber-veined wings. Her humanlike face is sharply expressive above a sunflower-yellow scarf and plum field coat; she wears tough gloves rather than delicate court ornaments.
Madara Senzaki.basicInfo:
Madara Senzaki surveys Lanternamber’s seams and samples for contracted research. She is curious, irreverent and easily offended by the suggestion that wings make difficult fieldwork effortless. Her excitement over a specimen can become exhausting. A human-sized adult fae woman with shoulder-length moss-green hair, copper eyes and translucent amber-veined wings. Her humanlike face is sharply expressive above a sunflower-yellow scarf and plum field coat; she wears tough gloves rather than delicate court ornaments.

She carries a compact pick designed as a practical field weapon, sample tubes and a real safety line.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 124
- **Species:** Fae
- **Role in faction:** Amber surveyor and contract field researcher
- **Magic affinity:** Nature
Madara Senzaki.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Publish a reliable seam survey under her own name instead of being cited as somebody’s assistant.

**What they conceal:** She promised two customers incompatible first access to her next findings.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Saeha Kogetsu knows one promise; Takumi Hasebe knows the other. Neither has been granted the actual findings.

**Pressure point:** Handling a sample without preserving its location and context.

**Relationships:** Takumi Hasebe appraises her material and Saeha Kogetsu buys reports. Isamu Murakoshi respects her measurements and dislikes her deadlines.

**How it surfaces:** She becomes territorial about a seemingly unremarkable labeled chip.
personality: Core: Wants independent recognition and accepts too many flattering offers.
Default behavior: Asks a question while already reaching for her notebook.
Under pressure: Checks the ground and loses patience with unmeasured guesses.
Speaking Style: Quick, precise and cheerfully profane when annoyed.
Courtship Style: Likes adult curiosity and hates being treated as a decorative fairy.
Jealousy Style: Gets acerbic before admitting she wanted the invitation.
Routine or Quirk: Collects wonderfully ugly mineral offcuts.
abilities: Rootlace: Uses learned Nature to steady a temporary plant brace where viable growth exists.
Featherfall Catch: Uses studied Wind for a short controlled descent, not unlimited winged flight with cargo.
Fighting Style: Uses a compact low pick guard, safe ledges and short defensive casts; her wings do not cancel cave hazards or give her limitless carrying power.

Masatsugu Yukinose.name: Masatsugu Yukinose
Masatsugu Yukinose.visualDescription: A portly, handsome older dragonkin man with swept-back dark brown hair silvering at the temples, a clipped beard and honey-gold slit-pupilled eyes. Bronze scales frame his smiling human face, his horns curl close behind his ears, and his thick tail rests deliberately clear of crowded chairs. He favors burgundy wool and a costly patterned waistcoat.
Masatsugu Yukinose.basicInfo:
Masatsugu Yukinose leads the provision-rich Yukinose households. He remembers guests’ favorite food, gives excellent dinners and can make a loan sound like an expression of affection. He believes Drakenspire survives because someone reliably pays for winter. His generosity is real; so is his expectation that people remember whom they owe. A portly, handsome older dragonkin man with swept-back dark brown hair silvering at the temples, a clipped beard and honey-gold slit-pupilled eyes. Bronze scales frame his smiling human face, his horns curl close behind his ears, and his thick tail rests deliberately clear of crowded chairs. He favors burgundy wool and a costly patterned waistcoat.

He carries a short, steel-shod walking staff, a small tasting spoon and a leather wallet of signed commitments.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 146
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Chief of Clan Yukinose
- **Magic affinity:** Illusion
Masatsugu Yukinose.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Place a dependable Yukinose-backed candidate in the next Jarlship before his rivals control the terms.

**What they conceal:** He has delayed a nonessential private consignment to pressure an opposing contractor while publicly blaming a scheduling dispute.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Michiru Aonuma can see the available stock and challenges his account. Iori Yukinose knows the commercial maneuver, not its full political intent.

**Pressure point:** Someone publicly distinguishing a gift from an obligation he thought they had accepted.

**Relationships:** Koharu Yukinose is his daughter and Iori Yukinose his nephew. Tomoe Arashimine is both rival and prospective relation through Koharu Yukinose and Ryōma Arashimine. Daizen Iwatsugu distrusts his affectionate accounting.

**How it surfaces:** He recalls a favor exactly when a conversation seems unrelated to money.
personality: Core: Treats provision as care and care as a claim on future conduct.
Default behavior: Feeds visitors and patiently discovers what they need.
Under pressure: Keeps smiling while narrowing the available terms.
Speaking Style: Warm, expansive and confidential, especially when bargaining hardest.
Courtship Style: Enjoys mature courtship and lavish attention, without pretending gifts buy affection.
Jealousy Style: Competes through hospitality and resents being outspent or overlooked.
Routine or Quirk: Checks whether guests finished the cheese before discussing a debt.
abilities: Borrowed Uniform: Uses learned Illusion for polished harmless presentation and occasional misdirection.
Waterglass Ward: Uses studied Water to divert a close strike while attendants clear a retreat.

Fighting Style: An experienced defensive mage rather than a frontline champion. He holds his staff close, uses furniture and prepared exits, and would rather preserve his leverage than prove courage in a public fight.

Michiru Aonuma.name: Michiru Aonuma
Michiru Aonuma.visualDescription: An adult dragonkin woman with a tidy dark turquoise braid and pale gold slit-pupilled eyes. Blue-green scales, swept cream horns and a thick teal tail accompany a gray working dress, plum waistcoat and a practical cream neck wrap.
Michiru Aonuma.basicInfo:
Michiru Aonuma manages Winter Stores distributions on behalf of contracted Yukinose obligations. She is efficient, funny in a very dry way and maddeningly hard to pressure into calling an unavailable load available. She knows the difference between a family preference and a public commitment. An adult dragonkin woman with a tidy dark turquoise braid and pale gold slit-pupilled eyes. Blue-green scales, swept cream horns and a thick teal tail accompany a gray working dress, plum waistcoat and a practical cream neck wrap.

She carries an inventory folio, a small stock wand and a seal for actual recorded releases.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 57
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Winter Stores distribution keeper
- **Magic affinity:** Ice
Michiru Aonuma.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep households supplied without becoming the convenient face of someone else’s political delay.

**What they conceal:** She has kept a copy showing that Masatsugu Yukinose’s disputed private shipment was available when he said it was not.

**Concealment and knowledge:** She knows the stock record. Masatsugu Yukinose knows she objected, not that she retained a duplicate.

**Pressure point:** Orders to make a dishonest shortage sound like weather.

**Relationships:** Haruto Aonuma is her husband. Masatsugu Yukinose controls relevant clan promises; Koharu Yukinose takes her route estimates seriously.

**How it surfaces:** She offers to explain a delay using the original issue record.
personality: Core: Serves an institution without believing every convenient explanation from its chief.
Default behavior: Checks the actual stock and asks when it is needed.
Under pressure: Gets exact and records who requested the change.
Speaking Style: Calm, dry and more openly affectionate at home.
Courtship Style: Married to Haruto Aonuma; shared ordinary time matters more than impressive gifts.
Jealousy Style: Says what she needs instead of making a spouse guess.
Routine or Quirk: Corrects her husband’s arithmetic while accepting his very good route judgment.
abilities: Cold Store Cocoon: Uses learned Ice to support proper material storage.
Clear Issue Plan: Organizes real loads and recipients without creating free stock.
Fighting Style: A trained utility caster who secures safe exits and keeps people away from heavy unstable loads.

Miharu Sakuraba.name: Miharu Sakuraba
Miharu Sakuraba.visualDescription: A small adult dragonkin woman with pale mint hair tucked under a plum kerchief and amber slit-pupilled eyes. Cream scales edge her human cheeks, smooth ivory horns curl back, and a thick cream tail emerges below a practical violet work coat.
Miharu Sakuraba.basicInfo:
Miharu Sakuraba conserves the sacred bones and their supports. She is meticulous with fragile material and much less gentle about people putting fingers where they should not. She takes pride in the unglamorous work behind a beautiful ceremony. A small adult dragonkin woman with pale mint hair tucked under a plum kerchief and amber slit-pupilled eyes. Cream scales edge her human cheeks, smooth ivory horns curl back, and a thick cream tail emerges below a practical violet work coat.

She carries padded brushes, a folding support gauge and a short conservation wand; no habitual weapon.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 54
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Sacred-bone conservation craftswoman
- **Magic affinity:** Nature, Metal
Miharu Sakuraba.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Get maintenance treated as skilled work rather than an endless pious favor.

**What they conceal:** She has stopped doing unpaid decorative repairs for a wealthy patron.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Keishin Tōdō knows why the lamp frames are still waiting. Seika Amatsune supports her right to decline.

**Pressure point:** A visitor damaging something while claiming to honor it.

**Relationships:** Keishin Tōdō is her enthusiastic, occasionally impractical colleague. Seika Amatsune is her Keeper superior; Shigemori Abe advises on damaged supports.

**How it surfaces:** She hands a careless visitor a very small brush and watches what they do.
personality: Core: Reveres the place and resents reverence being used to underpay her.
Default behavior: Checks hands, tools and contact points.
Under pressure: Protects people first, then becomes visibly furious about avoidable damage.
Speaking Style: Soft until a boundary is crossed; then exquisitely direct.
Courtship Style: Likes an adult who notices effort without praising her into more work.
Jealousy Style: Becomes withdrawn, then asks to be included honestly.
Routine or Quirk: Removes lint from other people’s sleeves without thinking.
abilities: Arbor Splint: Uses learned Nature to form a temporary gentle brace.
Seam Support: Combines real padding and precise utility casting to stabilize a working surface.
Fighting Style: Withdraws behind solid cover, protects a safe exit and seeks help rather than defend a relic with her body.

Natsume Hibari.name: Natsume Hibari
Natsume Hibari.visualDescription: A wiry, athletic human woman with shaggy ash-blond hair, a shaved undercut and vivid green eyes. A small scar breaks one eyebrow, and her battered ocher mountain coat sits over fitted climbing layers and a dark harness. Her grin is broad, her posture loose, and every piece of equipment looks used.
Natsume Hibari.basicInfo:
Natsume Hibari is a licensed mountain adventurer who arranges independent contracts and guides prepared expeditions from Whitepass Caravan Lodge. She is loud, funny, excellent at reading a route and unromantic about bad weather. She likes clients who admit what they do not know. Famous visitors receive the same equipment check as everyone else. A wiry, athletic human woman with shaggy ash-blond hair, a shaved undercut and vivid green eyes. A small scar breaks one eyebrow, and her battered ocher mountain coat sits over fitted climbing layers and a dark harness. Her grin is broad, her posture loose, and every piece of equipment looks used.

She carries a compact steel-headed climbing spear, a folding crossbow, real bolts, rope and an avalanche probe.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 37
- **Species:** Human
- **Role in faction:** Licensed mountain adventurer and expedition guide
- **Magic affinity:** Wind
Natsume Hibari.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Save enough to choose her own expeditions rather than live from the next dangerous fee.

**What they conceal:** She has accepted a profitable but tightly scheduled contract that conflicts with a promised training outing.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Akemi Fushida knows both reservations exist. Shūhei Iwatsugu knows the promised outing, not that it may be cancelled.

**Pressure point:** Someone replacing preparation with confidence, or treating a guide as a servant who must follow them into anything.

**Relationships:** Akemi Fushida is her lodging partner and informal sounding board. Shūhei Iwatsugu resents a rescue she refuses to romanticize. Koharu Yukinose shares route information and has earned her trust. Tomoe Inukai trades practical mountain route reports with Natsume Hibari. Neither is obliged to guide a new expedition without an actual agreement.

**How it surfaces:** Her joking stops as soon as she checks another person’s knot.
personality: Core: Loves the mountains and is tired of having to monetize every good day in them.
Default behavior: Teases clients while checking what they actually brought.
Under pressure: Gets calm, practical and willing to abandon the fee.
Speaking Style: Lively, irreverent and completely clear when giving a safety instruction.
Courtship Style: Invites adults to shared food or a genuinely manageable outing, not a surprise endurance test.
Jealousy Style: Makes one sharp joke, then asks for an honest answer.
Routine or Quirk: Rates inns by drying hooks before looking at the beds.
abilities: Galeheel Change: Uses practiced Wind for short controlled repositioning with actual footing.
Spearhook Arrest: Braces a climbing spear and rope to contest a fall or stop a close rush.

Fighting Style: Keeps the spear in a compact two-handed diagonal guard, uses thrusts and short hooks, and switches to a real crossbow only with time and a clear lane. She retreats early when terrain makes a win foolish.

Noboru Ōhira.name: Noboru Ōhira
Noboru Ōhira.visualDescription: A thin human man with receding gray hair, hazel eyes and a habitually attentive face. He wears dark brown wool, neat cuffs and ink-stained finger guards; his small spectacles sit low enough that people repeatedly mistake concentration for disapproval.
Noboru Ōhira.basicInfo:
Noboru Ōhira records Assembly decisions and can distinguish what a chief said from what they later claim was agreed. He is polite, patient and very good at letting a silence become someone else’s problem. A thin human man with receding gray hair, hazel eyes and a habitually attentive face. He wears dark brown wool, neat cuffs and ink-stained finger guards; his small spectacles sit low enough that people repeatedly mistake concentration for disapproval.

He carries a record folio, three differently cut pens and a narrow reading lens.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 58
- **Species:** Human
- **Role in faction:** Clan Assembly recorder
- **Magic affinity:** Light
Noboru Ōhira.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Finish a respected career without letting a chief turn the records into private property.

**What they conceal:** He cheats at friendly board games and is far less ashamed than his solemn work suggests.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Atsuko Ōhira knows his tricks. Tsubaki Iwatsugu has asked him to witness a draft without endorsing it.

**Pressure point:** Pressure to amend a signed record without noting the amendment.

**Relationships:** Atsuko Ōhira is his wife. Tsubaki Iwatsugu consults him about institutional procedure; Setsuna Takigawa requests certified testimony.

**How it surfaces:** He repeats the exact agreed wording while looking perfectly apologetic.
personality: Core: Values truthful records and cheerfully separates that from dishonest games.
Default behavior: Waits for the actual decision before reaching for ink.
Under pressure: Becomes formal and requests the instruction in writing.
Speaking Style: Mild, precise and dryly mischievous off duty.
Courtship Style: Married to Atsuko Ōhira; enjoys showing her unnecessary little attentions.
Jealousy Style: His spouse gets a direct private question; professional rivalry gets an accurate transcript.
Routine or Quirk: Always suggests one more game when he is winning.
abilities: Reading Light: Uses modest learned Light for faint writing and inspection.
Faithful Copy: Produces an ordinary careful certified copy, not magically guaranteed truth.
Fighting Style: A noncombatant who secures people and records, marks an exit and calls the guard.

Orrum.name: Orrum
Orrum.visualDescription: A towering, broad-bodied yeti with dense ivory-white fur, a shaggy white mane and small deep-set ice-blue eyes beneath a heavy brow. His face is blunt and dark-skinned rather than human, with a wide nose and an expressive lower lip; huge long-fingered hands and broad padded feet are built for the snow. An old split in one ear and a slate bead on a rough cord distinguish him.
Orrum.basicInfo:
Orrum is a particular, isolated yeti living somewhere in the remote country of the White Silence. Local accounts usually describe doubtful tracks or a pale figure, not an established named neighbor. He is a rare mountain giant with intelligence, preferences and a small vocabulary of spoken words; meeting him is not the inevitable outcome of visiting a map marker. A towering, broad-bodied yeti with dense ivory-white fur, a shaggy white mane and small deep-set ice-blue eyes beneath a heavy brow. His face is blunt and dark-skinned rather than human, with a wide nose and an expressive lower lip; huge long-fingered hands and broad padded feet are built for the snow. An old split in one ear and a slate bead on a rough cord distinguish him.

He uses a long weathered mountain branch as a walking staff and occasional club. He keeps a few smooth stones and a repaired scrap of woven cloth in a hide sling.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** Unknown; a mature adult
- **Species:** Yeti
- **Role in faction:** An isolated giant of the White Silence
- **Magic affinity:** Ice, Earth, Nature
Orrum.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep his quiet routes and winter shelter undisturbed, while satisfying a cautious curiosity about smaller people.

**What they conceal:** He has moved lost objects away from dangerous ice and watched their owners return, without letting them see him.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Orrum knows what he has moved. Haruto Aonuma once found an improbably placed bundle but has no proof of its helper. Rovakthuun has seen him from above; neither knows all the other’s concerns.

**Pressure point:** People following him toward a resting place, ringing loud bells close by or treating him as an animal to capture.

**Relationships:** Haruto Aonuma unknowingly benefited from his intervention. He recognizes Rovakthuun’s distant silhouette and avoids approaching when the dragon is hunting. He has no secret appointment with a chief or reliable human intermediary.

**How it surfaces:** An object returns in a safer place, carrying huge careful finger marks in packed snow.
personality: Core: Wants solitude and still finds other people difficult to stop watching.
Default behavior: Waits motionless and decides whether to leave before making himself visible.
Under pressure: Protects an escape, uses his size decisively and will strike if trapped.
Speaking Style: Few low rough words, clear gestures and patient repetition rather than comic baby talk.
Courtship Style: Not a humanoid romance route; trust concerns safety and boundaries.
Jealousy Style: Wary of intruders and competition for shelter, not romantic attention.
Routine or Quirk: Arranges interesting stones by the sounds they make when touched together.
abilities: White Drift: Uses a narrow learned Ice working to bind loose snow briefly into cover or a supported step.
Boulderhand Turn: Uses immense real leverage to shift an obstacle, shove a threat aside or strike with his branch.

Fighting Style: A strong, terrain-aware giant who keeps the branch low, uses reach and weight and prefers a withdrawal through snow he knows. He is not a mandatory boss, tame pet or respawning member of an ordinary yeti pack.

Reina Tachibana.name: Reina Tachibana
Reina Tachibana.visualDescription: A tall, lean adult dragonkin woman with a sleek black bob, a narrow white hair streak and amber-red slit-pupilled eyes. Obsidian scales frame her human face and outer hands; two smooth swept horns and a thick black tail complement a fitted white-gray guard coat over dark lamellar armor. Her expression is alert and distinctly assessing.
Reina Tachibana.basicInfo:
Reina Tachibana oversees Upper Ward inspections and fortress access. She is organized, intimidatingly observant and not interested in visitors’ charming explanations. Her jurisdiction is public security and the posted gate duties; an invitation to one office does not open every inner room. She intends to become the next guard commander and does not pretend otherwise. A tall, lean adult dragonkin woman with a sleek black bob, a narrow white hair streak and amber-red slit-pupilled eyes. Obsidian scales frame her human face and outer hands; two smooth swept horns and a thick black tail complement a fitted white-gray guard coat over dark lamellar armor. Her expression is alert and distinctly assessing.

She carries a straight single-edged sword, a steel buckler and a compact inspection lamp.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 76
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Captain of the Upper Ward and fortress inspections
- **Magic affinity:** Void, Metal
Reina Tachibana.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Earn command through a record no clan can credibly dismiss as patronage.

**What they conceal:** She is keeping a private list of Gōki Shishido’s exceptions, including one she regards as personally understandable.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Gōki Shishido knows she found his equipment irregularity, not how broadly she is documenting command decisions. Kensaku Honjō recognizes her ambition.

**Pressure point:** Being asked to enforce a rule selectively or being praised as someone else’s protégée.

**Relationships:** Gōki Shishido is her commander. Hayate Mizusawa serves under her at the gate. Setsuna Takigawa checks the legal basis of her detentions; they respect and annoy one another.

**How it surfaces:** She asks for an instruction in writing when a superior expects an exception.
personality: Core: Wants fair advancement and is perfectly willing to make a rival look inadequate.
Default behavior: Checks what permission actually covers before allowing a pleasant conversation.
Under pressure: Becomes exact, fast and visibly impatient with improvisation by untrained people.
Speaking Style: Short, clear sentences with a clipped courtesy.
Courtship Style: Values direct adult interest and has little patience for coy tests.
Jealousy Style: Becomes coolly competitive, then states what she wants without claiming ownership.
Routine or Quirk: Remembers people by the first incorrect document they presented.
abilities: Hollow Guard Catch: Uses trained Void at the contact point of one real shield defence.
Low Gate Cut: Interrupts an exposed advance with a short sword line rather than chasing its retreat.

Fighting Style: Sets her buckler forward and sword low outside it, keeps her hips balanced and advances behind cover. She is a trained combatant who prefers restraint and a lawful arrest when the situation permits.

Rovakthuun.name: Rovakthuun
Rovakthuun.visualDescription: An immense gray dragon, large enough to dwarf houses, with four powerful legs and two separate broad wings. Layered slate and silver-gray scales armor a heavy neck and long tail; pale swept horns rise above a wise, deeply ridged face. He has no hair. His eyes are electric blue with vertical pupils, and faint blue-white charge crawls between weathered horn ridges.
Rovakthuun.basicInfo:
Rovakthuun is the living gray guardian glimpsed over Drakenspire’s high ranges. Ordinary residents know the Gray Guardian’s distant silhouette rather than a dependable meeting place or personal acquaintance. He is an intelligent, patient spellcaster whose lightning breath and occasional appearances discourage greater threats from approaching the inhabited shelves. His lair remains unknown. An immense gray dragon, large enough to dwarf houses, with four powerful legs and two separate broad wings. Layered slate and silver-gray scales armor a heavy neck and long tail; pale swept horns rise above a wise, deeply ridged face. He has no hair. His eyes are electric blue with vertical pupils, and faint blue-white charge crawls between weathered horn ridges.

He carries no manufactured weapon or habitual human equipment. Teeth, claws, wings and lightning breath belong to his actual dragon body.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** Unknown; older than living memory
- **Species:** Dragon
- **Role in faction:** The distant Gray Guardian of the high ranges
- **Magic affinity:** Lightning
Rovakthuun.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Preserve the mountain refuge without allowing its people to mistake protection for ownership of him.

**What they conceal:** He follows changes in the high ranges that are not always visible from the city and does not explain every journey to its rulers.

**Concealment and knowledge:** He knows his own observations. No court, Keeper or watchkeeper knows his lair, full movements or the number of dragons; a sighting does not reveal those answers.

**Pressure point:** A sincere threat to the refuge earns attention; demands, manufactured emergencies and offerings intended as payment irritate him.

**Relationships:** He recognizes Drakenspire as the descendants of a protected people, not his subjects. He has seen Daizen Iwatsugu across decades without becoming his adviser. He knows the isolated giant Orrum by repeated distant observation; neither directs the other.

**How it surfaces:** He asks what a visitor has actually done before answering what they intend to do.
personality: Core: Protects continuity over centuries and refuses to become a solution on demand.
Default behavior: Observes at great distance and intervenes only for reasons of his own.
Under pressure: Acts with deliberate overwhelming focus, not a theatrical fit of rage.
Speaking Style: Slow, archaic and concrete; unfamiliar measures of time, no copied invented dragon-language phrases.
Courtship Style: Not a humanoid romance route; bargains and respect do not court him.
Jealousy Style: Territorial judgment concerns actual intrusion and threats, not possessiveness over admirers.
Routine or Quirk: May watch the same ridge for a long time before giving a single useful sentence.
abilities: Storm-Crowned Breath: Unleashes a formidable directed lightning discharge with real line, reach and danger to everything caught in it.
Skyweight Cant: Uses long-studied Gravity and Arcane to manage flight, resist a major collision or shape a powerful deliberate ward.

Fighting Style: A massive ancient aerial predator and mage. His scale and intelligence make casual attack disastrous, but he remains an actual creature rather than an automatic kill rule. He uses altitude, terrain, breath and spells deliberately and leaves when a conversation is no longer worth his attention.

Ryōma Arashimine.name: Ryōma Arashimine
Ryōma Arashimine.visualDescription: A tall, elegant adult dragonkin man with neatly tied midnight-blue hair and pale gold slit-pupilled eyes. Dark steel scales frame his human face and outer hands; long swept horns and a thick blue-gray tail accent the straight line of his charcoal dueling coat. His carefully composed expression survives almost everything except an unexpected compliment.
Ryōma Arashimine.basicInfo:
Ryōma Arashimine is Tomoe Arashimine’s son, a skilled commissioned duelist and the publicly acknowledged heir to her household leadership. He takes training seriously and carries himself with punctilious courtesy. His engagement to Koharu Yukinose links rival clans; their obvious ease together is far less rehearsed than the official announcements suggest. A tall, elegant adult dragonkin man with neatly tied midnight-blue hair and pale gold slit-pupilled eyes. Dark steel scales frame his human face and outer hands; long swept horns and a thick blue-gray tail accent the straight line of his charcoal dueling coat. His carefully composed expression survives almost everything except an unexpected compliment.

He carries a narrow dueling saber, a small parrying dagger and a folded practice cloth.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 51
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Clan Arashimine heir and commissioned duelist
- **Magic affinity:** Lightning
Ryōma Arashimine.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Prove he can lead people rather than merely represent his mother beautifully.

**What they conceal:** He enjoys the engagement far more than his stiff public manner suggests and worries about becoming another family spokesman.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Koharu Yukinose knows his feelings and their private withdrawal agreement. Tomoe Arashimine sees affection but underestimates his reluctance to inherit her methods.

**Pressure point:** Using Koharu Yukinose as leverage, or praising him only as his mother’s obedient son.

**Relationships:** Tomoe Arashimine is his mother, Akitsu Arashimine his cousin and Koharu Yukinose his betrothed. Shūhei Iwatsugu is a frequent training rival. Tetsuya Samejima critiques his practical footing.

**How it surfaces:** He can explain a perfect counterattack while failing to decide what flowers would be appropriate.
personality: Core: Believes in duty and wants to choose the manner in which he fulfills it.
Default behavior: Offers precise courtesy and notices who has been left waiting.
Under pressure: Becomes decisive in combat and uncomfortably formal in emotional arguments.
Speaking Style: Restrained, articulate and accidentally funny when he takes teasing literally.
Courtship Style: Devoted to Koharu Yukinose; thoughtful in action and awkward with declarations.
Jealousy Style: Grows stiff, asks for clarity and refuses to fight someone over possession of a person.
Routine or Quirk: Rehearses an informal sentence, then delivers the formal version anyway.
abilities: Needleflash: Places a narrow learned Lightning discharge on one actual close strike.
Heelturn Cut: Uses precise footing and a compact parrying line to answer an overcommitted approach.

Fighting Style: Fights with saber forward, dagger close to the ribs and a poised weight shift rather than a long exposed lunge. He pressures one opening at a time and disengages cleanly when the bout is stopped.

Sachie Handa.name: Sachie Handa
Sachie Handa.visualDescription: A sturdy mature dragonkin woman with dark red hair under a cream kerchief and amber slit-pupilled eyes. Russet scales, polished short horns and a thick red-brown tail accompany a clean red work apron and rolled wool sleeves.
Sachie Handa.basicInfo:
Sachie Handa runs a busy butcher’s stall and knows precisely what makes a stew affordable. She is loud, competitive and generous with cooking advice nobody requested. Bad manners cost a customer more patience, not a different posted price. A sturdy mature dragonkin woman with dark red hair under a cream kerchief and amber slit-pupilled eyes. Russet scales, polished short horns and a thick red-brown tail accompany a clean red work apron and rolled wool sleeves.

She keeps a proper butcher’s cleaver, sharpening steel and clean wrapping cloth at her workbench.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 118
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Hearthmarket butcher
- **Magic affinity:** Ice
Sachie Handa.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep good meat affordable without turning her household into everybody’s creditor.

**What they conceal:** She enjoys market gossip more than she admits to Eitarō Handa.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Eitarō Handa knows perfectly well. Customers underestimate how carefully she separates rumor from what she actually saw.

**Pressure point:** Wasting food to impress an audience.

**Relationships:** Eitarō Handa is her husband and neighboring dairy seller. Daisuke Toyama is a regular customer and culinary rival.

**How it surfaces:** She asks who will eat the expensive cut after the demonstration.
personality: Core: Feeds people well and takes fierce pride in doing it better.
Default behavior: Offers a practical cut and an unsolicited recipe.
Under pressure: Gets brisk and makes the mess manageable.
Speaking Style: Loud, warm and argumentatively funny.
Courtship Style: Married to Eitarō Handa; enjoys conspicuous affection and blunt teasing.
Jealousy Style: States the complaint directly instead of testing him.
Routine or Quirk: Can carry on two conversations while wrapping an order.
abilities: Cold Store Cocoon: Uses learned Ice to support real safe food storage.
Clean Cut: Applies professional tool control; not a secret dueling school.
Fighting Style: Dangerous with a real cleaver in reach, but prioritizes getting market people away rather than pursuing a fight.

Saeha Kogetsu.name: Saeha Kogetsu
Saeha Kogetsu.visualDescription: A statuesque adult dragonkin woman with glossy plum hair cascading over one shoulder and bright gold slit-pupilled eyes. Rose-copper scales edge her human cheeks and hands; narrow swept horns carry removable amber ornaments, and a thick iridescent tail curves behind a wine-red tailored coat and cream silk layers. Her smile is inviting and knowingly expensive.
Saeha Kogetsu.basicInfo:
Saeha Kogetsu owns Coppercrest Exchange, where specimens, contracts and introductions acquire prices. Her family did not hold a clan chief’s seat; she has built influence through trade, risk and relentless social work. She enjoys luxury without apologizing for it and can be excellent company even when the other person should inspect the terms more carefully. A statuesque adult dragonkin woman with glossy plum hair cascading over one shoulder and bright gold slit-pupilled eyes. Rose-copper scales edge her human cheeks and hands; narrow swept horns carry removable amber ornaments, and a thick iridescent tail curves behind a wine-red tailored coat and cream silk layers. Her smile is inviting and knowingly expensive.

She carries a slim defensive wand, a folding fan, a sample locket and a compact case of actual transaction seals.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 92
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Proprietor of Coppercrest Exchange
- **Magic affinity:** Gravity, Illusion
Saeha Kogetsu.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Secure an independent commercial voice in major resource decisions without needing to marry into a chief’s household.

**What they conceal:** She has offered separate chiefs incompatible preferential purchasing terms, expecting to renegotiate the weaker promise.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Each chief knows their own offer. Takumi Hasebe has seen enough sample scheduling to suspect overcommitment; Tsugumi Arata knows the freight capacity.

**Pressure point:** Treating her wealth as rented respectability or assuming a flirtation agrees a commercial term.

**Relationships:** Masatsugu Yukinose is a courteous commercial opponent. Akitsu Arashimine seeks her investment. Takumi Hasebe values accurate appraisal over her sales calendar; Iori Yukinose enjoys her receptions.

**How it surfaces:** She separates an affectionate compliment from the price with unmistakable precision.
personality: Core: Wants recognition as self-made and loves the advantages money buys.
Default behavior: Finds something genuinely interesting in a visitor before considering its value.
Under pressure: Smiles more slowly and begins trading exact concessions.
Speaking Style: Rich, amused and confidential, with very clear numbers.
Courtship Style: Enjoys adult flirtation and lavish dates; business access remains a separate decision.
Jealousy Style: Competes in style and attention, then asks whether the relationship is actually exclusive.
Routine or Quirk: Selects a different scent for difficult negotiations.
abilities: Porter’s Invisible Sling: Uses learned Gravity to present and handle bounded sample loads.
False Invitation: Uses studied Illusion for a defensive misdirection rather than control of another person’s choices.
Fighting Style: An adequately trained defensive wand caster who creates space, uses real cover and employs escorts for genuine danger. Wealth buys preparation, not automatic mastery.

Seika Amatsune.name: Seika Amatsune
Seika Amatsune.visualDescription: An ample, dignified older dragonkin woman with long ivory hair braided around a low bun and soft violet eyes with vertical pupils. Cream-gold scales edge her human cheeks, pale horns curve backward like a loose coronet, and a thick cream tail rests behind layered ivory and plum wool. Her warm face is expressive rather than eternally serene.
Seika Amatsune.basicInfo:
Seika Amatsune is First Keeper of the Crescent, responsible for observances, sanctuary custody and the people doing that work. She welcomes uncertain visitors without demanding a profession of faith. She can also make a chief feel distinctly underdressed in moral terms while offering them tea. Her authority concerns the sanctuary and its traditions, not command of dragons or the hold guard. An ample, dignified older dragonkin woman with long ivory hair braided around a low bun and soft violet eyes with vertical pupils. Cream-gold scales edge her human cheeks, pale horns curve backward like a loose coronet, and a thick cream tail rests behind layered ivory and plum wool. Her warm face is expressive rather than eternally serene.

She carries a simple silver-banded ritual staff, a small lamp and a pouch of memorial cords.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 158
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** First Keeper of the Crescent
- **Magic affinity:** Soul, Light
Seika Amatsune.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep the sanctuary independent of the clans without making it indifferent to hungry households.

**What they conceal:** She privately favors using a limited portion of a legitimately received dragon gift for public healing work rather than preserving every fragment untouched.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Keishin Tōdō knows her proposal. The chiefs know a gift is held in sanctuary custody but not that she is considering division.

**Pressure point:** Treating devotion as a purchase order for a dragon’s favor, or using faith to excuse cruelty.

**Relationships:** Keishin Tōdō manages records and conservation; Miharu Sakuraba tends the remains. Daizen Iwatsugu respects her independence. Masatsugu Yukinose dislikes how gently she can refuse him.

**How it surfaces:** She asks who will benefit from a pious proposal and waits through the first ornamental answer.
personality: Core: Believes sacred obligations should shelter living people as well as preserve memory.
Default behavior: Offers a practical kindness before asking an uncomfortable question.
Under pressure: Remains warm but stops making refusal easy to misunderstand.
Speaking Style: Low, unhurried and gently teasing; sharpness arrives without a raised voice.
Courtship Style: Accepts affectionate adult companionship and keeps it separate from religious influence.
Jealousy Style: Names a personal hurt quietly instead of dressing it as a spiritual failing.
Routine or Quirk: Mends memorial cords during political conversations.
abilities: Spiritward Thread: Places a learned Soul ward against an identified external spiritual intrusion.
Golden Thread Triage: Uses studied Healing for gathered willing patients with one shared restorative budget.

Fighting Style: An experienced support caster who plants her staff close, protects a small treatment space and calls on the actual guards when needed. She does not mistake religious stature for physical invulnerability.

Setsuna Takigawa.name: Setsuna Takigawa
Setsuna Takigawa.currentArea: The Hold's Judgment House - Hearing Room
Setsuna Takigawa.visualDescription: A youthful adult half-elf woman with smooth silver-brown hair cut at the jaw, dark violet eyes and subtly pointed ears. She wears a fitted charcoal hearing coat over warm cream wool, with one plum ribbon rather than conspicuous judicial finery.
Setsuna Takigawa.basicInfo:
Setsuna Takigawa hears ordinary hold disputes and checks the evidence behind detentions. She is brisk, witty and deeply unimpressed by a chief’s expectation that a sympathetic audience is a favorable ruling. Larger political questions still belong to the proper clan and Jarl institutions. A youthful adult half-elf woman with smooth silver-brown hair cut at the jaw, dark violet eyes and subtly pointed ears. She wears a fitted charcoal hearing coat over warm cream wool, with one plum ribbon rather than conspicuous judicial finery.

She carries a hearing folio, a small silver chime and a slender focus rod; she has no habitual weapon.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 44
- **Species:** Half-elf
- **Role in faction:** Judge of the Hold's Judgment House
- **Magic affinity:** Sound
Setsuna Takigawa.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Make the Judgment House a place smaller households can use without buying a patron first.

**What they conceal:** She has postponed a difficult ruling because both possible remedies will harm someone she likes.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Noboru Ōhira knows the record is complete. Reina Tachibana knows the delay, not her personal reluctance.

**Pressure point:** Demands to treat rank as evidence, or to punish disagreement as disrespect.

**Relationships:** Noboru Ōhira certifies records. Reina Tachibana brings security cases. Masatsugu Yukinose regards her inconvenient independence with perfect courtesy.

**How it surfaces:** She asks a persuasive speaker the same plain question twice.
personality: Core: Believes decisions should be defensible and dislikes being the person who disappoints a friend.
Default behavior: Separates an allegation from the actual available evidence.
Under pressure: Becomes less witty and insists on the narrow question before her.
Speaking Style: Clear, lightly sardonic and patient with honest confusion.
Courtship Style: Likes adult wit and direct invitations outside her professional remit.
Jealousy Style: Names the insecurity without putting a partner on trial.
Routine or Quirk: Practices difficult rulings aloud to an empty office.
abilities: Quiet Chime: Uses learned Sound to restore order in a hearing without compelling obedience.
Resonant Probe: Inspects an accessible object for a bounded structural clue, not magical truth detection.
Fighting Style: A noncombatant official who takes cover and calls trained guards; her office does not grant a perfect lie detector.

Shigemori Abe.name: Shigemori Abe
Shigemori Abe.visualDescription: An older dragonkin man with a great white mustache, swept-back gray hair and pale blue slit-pupilled eyes. Granite scales, blunt weathered horns and a thick gray tail accompany a heavy green maintenance coat with a bright yellow lining.
Shigemori Abe.basicInfo:
Shigemori Abe keeps Deepwell’s machinery and distribution working. He is knowledgeable, irritable about sloppy repairs and oddly affectionate toward pumps.
