He is not interested in converting a practical water system into a fashionable mystery. An older dragonkin man with a great white mustache, swept-back gray hair and pale blue slit-pupilled eyes. Granite scales, blunt weathered horns and a thick gray tail accompany a heavy green maintenance coat with a bright yellow lining.

He carries a heavy pipe wrench, a real pressure gauge and a small diagnostic wand.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 151
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Deepwell senior maintenance engineer
- **Magic affinity:** Water
Shigemori Abe.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Get a patient apprentice trained before his own hands make retirement unavoidable.

**What they conceal:** He has postponed an ordinary joint replacement rather than admit the system needs a planned closure.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Tsubaki Iwatsugu knows the replacement request, not the full delay. Miharu Sakuraba recognizes his habit of maintaining things past a sensible interval.

**Pressure point:** Treating maintenance as optional until something stops working.

**Relationships:** Tsubaki Iwatsugu coordinates works costs. Miharu Sakuraba asks about supports; Daisuke Toyama depends on reliable supply and complains usefully.

**How it surfaces:** He remembers the age of a fitting more readily than a visitor’s title.
personality: Core: Wants the system to outlast him and dislikes proving it can run without him.
Default behavior: Listens to the machinery before an explanation.
Under pressure: Closes the unsafe section and gives short exact jobs.
Speaking Style: Gruff, technical and quietly fond of a well-made part.
Courtship Style: Enjoys adult companionship that does not treat aging as helplessness.
Jealousy Style: Gets withdrawn, then says what he misses.
Routine or Quirk: Apologizes to equipment before opening its housing.
abilities: Current Routing: Uses learned Water only alongside real valves and channels.
Insulated Bypass: Makes a temporary repair with actual suitable parts.
Fighting Style: A capable worksite responder who isolates hazards and withdraws; the wrench is a practical last defence, not a legendary weapon.

Shino Kazamaki.name: Shino Kazamaki
Shino Kazamaki.visualDescription: A stylish adult dragonkin woman with pale pink hair in a loose side ponytail and green slit-pupilled eyes. Fine pearl scales trace her human cheekbones; small ivory horns and a thick pale rose tail complement a blue fitted wool dress and bright patterned shawl.
Shino Kazamaki.basicInfo:
Shino Kazamaki owns The Woolen Wyvern. She loves fashion, understands mountain weather and can explain why an expensive look will be miserable on a real pass. She is sociable and not especially discreet about a badly designed outfit. A stylish adult dragonkin woman with pale pink hair in a loose side ponytail and green slit-pupilled eyes. Fine pearl scales trace her human cheekbones; small ivory horns and a thick pale rose tail complement a blue fitted wool dress and bright patterned shawl.

She carries a narrow fitting wand, pins, cloth swatches and a small mirror.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 42
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Clothier and owner of The Woolen Wyvern
- **Magic affinity:** Illusion
Shino Kazamaki.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Grow a recognizable local style rather than copy whatever arrives from Glowhaven.

**What they conceal:** She bought too much impractical imported cloth and is determined to sell it without lying about its limits.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Atsuko Ōhira knows the stock. Saeha Kogetsu supplied the introduction and expects no automatic refund.

**Pressure point:** Assuming a fashionable woman cannot understand practical work.

**Relationships:** Atsuko Ōhira handles referred repairs. Hibiki Takanashi coordinates armor fit. Iori Yukinose is an enthusiastic and occasionally tiresome customer.

**How it surfaces:** She asks where someone will actually wear the beautiful coat.
personality: Core: Values individual style and has expensive tastes her accounts occasionally resent.
Default behavior: Notices one good detail before proposing a change.
Under pressure: Gets quick, inventive and unapologetically direct.
Speaking Style: Chatty, observant and a little wicked.
Courtship Style: Open adult flirtation, with business and invitations clearly separated.
Jealousy Style: Compares herself too much, then admits she wants reassurance.
Routine or Quirk: Changes her shawl when a conversation has gone badly.
abilities: Borrowed Uniform: Uses learned Illusion for temporary fitting previews without changing real clothes.
Threadkeeper’s Knot: Supports an actual seam with a studied temporary enchantment.
Fighting Style: Leaves by a clear route, helps customers out and uses a brief visual distraction rather than fighting over merchandise.

Shūhei Iwatsugu.name: Shūhei Iwatsugu
Shūhei Iwatsugu.visualDescription: A lean, broad-backed young adult dragonkin man with rust-red hair cut unevenly at the nape and bright green slit-pupilled eyes. Umber scales climb his jaw and outer arms; one swept horn is chipped, and his thick dark tail bears an old pale scar. He wears a short moss-green expedition coat over a thick ocher sweater.
Shūhei Iwatsugu.basicInfo:
Shūhei Iwatsugu surveys works routes and is campaigning to lead expeditions under his own name. He has real field skill, a quick grin and an exhausting talent for turning a reasonable objection into a personal challenge. Being related to the Jarl gets him doors opened; he loudly claims that he would rather kick them down himself. A lean, broad-backed young adult dragonkin man with rust-red hair cut unevenly at the nape and bright green slit-pupilled eyes. Umber scales climb his jaw and outer arms; one swept horn is chipped, and his thick dark tail bears an old pale scar. He wears a short moss-green expedition coat over a thick ocher sweater.

He carries a long ash-shafted glaive with a hooked steel head, a survey cord and a roll of trail sketches.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 39
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Clan Iwatsugu works surveyor and aspiring expedition leader
- **Magic affinity:** Wind, Earth, Lightning
Shūhei Iwatsugu.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Earn a reputation that is not introduced with the name Daizen Iwatsugu.

**What they conceal:** He once accepted a rescue he now describes as a successful joint retreat.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Natsume Hibari performed the rescue and refuses to endorse his revised version. Tsubaki Iwatsugu knows the bill, not every detail.

**Pressure point:** An audience hearing that he needed help, especially one he was trying to impress.

**Relationships:** Daizen Iwatsugu is his great-uncle and Tsubaki Iwatsugu his cousin. Natsume Hibari tests his field judgment; Ryōma Arashimine is an admired rival he pretends to find tedious.

**How it surfaces:** He volunteers first, then becomes unusually specific about who will be bringing ropes.
personality: Core: Wants independence while enjoying the privileges that make it easier.
Default behavior: Turns ordinary competence into a small performance.
Under pressure: Moves decisively in familiar terrain; gets prickly when someone else must lead.
Speaking Style: Fast, cheeky and competitive, with very transparent wounded dignity.
Courtship Style: Flirts confidently until someone takes his interest seriously.
Jealousy Style: Shows off and makes foolish comparisons he later regrets.
Routine or Quirk: Practices impressive glaive flourishes when he thinks nobody is watching.
abilities: Galeheel Change: Uses learned Wind to sharpen a short real reposition around his glaive’s reach.
Hook and Turn: Catches a guard or limb with the glaive hook and contests its balance.

Fighting Style: Uses a long two-handed diagonal guard, quick changes of grip and thrusts from outside sword range. He likes winning visibly and can overextend after an insult; a serious expedition forces him to prioritize retreat routes.

Suzune Hanekawa.name: Suzune Hanekawa
Suzune Hanekawa.visualDescription: A striking adult human woman with long raspberry-red hair, amber-brown eyes and expressive brows. She wears a deep blue rehearsal dress, a short cream winter cape and mismatched stage earrings she claims are deliberate.
Suzune Hanekawa.basicInfo:
Suzune Hanekawa is Snowbell’s leading actress. She loves an audience, works harder than her dazzling entrances suggest and considers a bad rehearsal a personal insult. Outside performance she is charming, vain and often genuinely funny. A striking adult human woman with long raspberry-red hair, amber-brown eyes and expressive brows. She wears a deep blue rehearsal dress, a short cream winter cape and mismatched stage earrings she claims are deliberate.

She carries a slim stage wand, rehearsal pages and a small makeup case.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 28
- **Species:** Human
- **Role in faction:** Leading actress at Snowbell Playhouse
- **Magic affinity:** Illusion
Suzune Hanekawa.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Produce a new local play instead of repeating safe imported favorites forever.

**What they conceal:** She advertised an ambitious premiere before securing the costumes or final text.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Iroha Sagiri knows the gap. Iori Yukinose promised support but has not confirmed every expense.

**Pressure point:** Assuming that being glamorous means the work is effortless.

**Relationships:** Iroha Sagiri is a trusted artistic friend. Iori Yukinose is a sponsor. Tamaki Naruse follows her work and is being very obvious about it.

**How it surfaces:** She rehearses a supposedly spontaneous remark until somebody laughs.
personality: Core: Wants artistic respect and loves the applause that can distract from it.
Default behavior: Turns an ordinary arrival into a little event.
Under pressure: Gets exact, theatrical and briefly impossible to please.
Speaking Style: Bright, dramatic and quick to puncture her own grand line.
Courtship Style: Enjoys clear adult interest; likes a person who notices the work too.
Jealousy Style: Competes for the room, then admits she wanted one person’s attention.
Routine or Quirk: Repeats a compliment later as if testing its rhythm.
abilities: Hallway Rehearsal: Uses learned Illusion to preview a small staged scene.
Voice Projection: Uses studied Sound to carry a real performance without forcing emotion.
Fighting Style: Uses a brief distraction, a clear exit and actual staff coordination; stage magic is not mind control.

Takumi Hasebe.name: Takumi Hasebe
Takumi Hasebe.visualDescription: A slim adult dragonkin man with ink-blue hair combed back and pale yellow slit-pupilled eyes behind square spectacles. Indigo scales, neat swept horns and a thick dark tail suit his gray-blue work coat and carefully clean pale gloves.
Takumi Hasebe.basicInfo:
Takumi Hasebe examines submitted materials at Amberglass. He is competent, dry and utterly uninterested in how much a customer hopes a specimen is worth. A sober written finding from him often saves more money than an exciting sales pitch. A slim adult dragonkin man with ink-blue hair combed back and pale yellow slit-pupilled eyes behind square spectacles. Indigo scales, neat swept horns and a thick dark tail suit his gray-blue work coat and carefully clean pale gloves.

He carries a brass loupe, a small examination wand and a padded case of reference chips.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 52
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Assayer at Amberglass
- **Magic affinity:** Light
Takumi Hasebe.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep his findings trusted even when doing so costs profitable clients.

**What they conceal:** He has been losing money at friendly prediction pools and hiding it badly.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Saeha Kogetsu has noticed the nervous little loans. Hotaru Kise knows his tastes run beyond his budget.

**Pressure point:** Offering money for a stronger conclusion than the specimen supports.

**Relationships:** Saeha Kogetsu buys independent findings, not ownership of them. Madara Senzaki supplies field context; Hotaru Kise prepares cuts for inspection.

**How it surfaces:** He corrects a technically flattering description before accepting thanks.
personality: Core: Demands honest measurements and makes foolish personal bets.
Default behavior: Examines the actual sample before discussing its story.
Under pressure: Becomes clipped and follows the method carefully.
Speaking Style: Dry, precise and unexpectedly funny about bad evidence.
Courtship Style: Awkward adult interest expressed through thoughtful, modest plans.
Jealousy Style: Withdraws into precision, then asks a plain question.
Routine or Quirk: Claims he has stopped betting just before checking the odds.
abilities: Moonlit Margin: Uses learned Light to reveal shallow surface detail.
Resonant Probe: Uses studied Sound and instruments to assess an exposed flaw.
Fighting Style: A trained utility caster who shields a retreat and secures dangerous samples; not a combat specialist.

Tamaki Naruse.name: Tamaki Naruse
Tamaki Naruse.visualDescription: A short, powerfully built adult dragonkin woman with a silver-white undercut and red slit-pupilled eyes. Black pearl scales frame her human grin; compact swept horns and a thick charcoal tail complement a scarlet cropped training jacket over opaque black athletic layers.
Tamaki Naruse.basicInfo:
Tamaki Naruse wrestles and takes contracted bouts at the Cinder Pit. She is competitive, loud and cheerfully unimpressed by a duelist who has never been grabbed. She loves the crowd and takes agreed stops seriously. A short, powerfully built adult dragonkin woman with a silver-white undercut and red slit-pupilled eyes. Black pearl scales frame her human grin; compact swept horns and a thick charcoal tail complement a scarlet cropped training jacket over opaque black athletic layers.

She carries a broad-headed short mace, reinforced handwraps and a small pouch of actual booking tokens.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 36
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Cinder Pit wrestler and contracted duelist
- **Magic affinity:** Gravity
Tamaki Naruse.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Earn enough from honest matches to stop relying on an unreliable promoter.

**What they conceal:** She is avoiding asking whether Suzune Hanekawa’s friendliness means anything personal.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Iroha Sagiri has noticed. Suzune Hanekawa knows Tamaki Naruse attends, not every nervous rehearsal of an invitation.

**Pressure point:** Someone refusing a clean loss or using an injury as entertainment.

**Relationships:** Gentarō Bando books her bouts. Suzune Hanekawa is her current adult crush; Iroha Sagiri teases her without promising reciprocity. Tetsuya Samejima critiques her footing.

**How it surfaces:** She becomes suddenly unconvincing at indifference when the playhouse is mentioned.
personality: Core: Loves a contest and dislikes feeling emotionally outmatched.
Default behavior: Challenges an exaggerated claim with a grin.
Under pressure: Gets focused and protects the actual stopping condition.
Speaking Style: Loud, plain and full of shameless competitive teasing.
Courtship Style: Direct with adults in theory, comically hesitant with a real crush.
Jealousy Style: Gets bratty, then asks whether she is inventing a competition.
Routine or Quirk: Tests new nicknames aloud until somebody tells her to stop.
abilities: Gravitic Drive: Uses learned Gravity to support one actual close strike.
Bear’s Short Clinch: Uses trained grips and real leverage to restrict an opponent.
Fighting Style: Keeps a compact mace guard, weight low but standing, and closes behind short steps before grappling. She is dangerous nearby and unwilling to pretend a long-range fight suits her.

Tetsuya Samejima.name: Tetsuya Samejima
Tetsuya Samejima.visualDescription: A thick-necked adult dragonkin man with cropped sandy hair and pale green slit-pupilled eyes. Steel-gray scales, heavy swept horns and a thick gray tail accompany a faded green training coat; two missing finger tips make his left grip distinctive.
Tetsuya Samejima.basicInfo:
Tetsuya Samejima teaches practical fighting at Stonefang. He is competent, blunt and almost impossible to impress with a flourish. He likes students who return after an ordinary bad session more than visitors selling a legendary technique. A thick-necked adult dragonkin man with cropped sandy hair and pale green slit-pupilled eyes. Steel-gray scales, heavy swept horns and a thick gray tail accompany a faded green training coat; two missing finger tips make his left grip distinctive.

He carries a short training axe, a weighted practice staff and repair cord for the equipment shelter.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 87
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Stonefang instructor
- **Magic affinity:** Enchantment, Earth
Tetsuya Samejima.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Build a stable school of practical instruction without becoming a chief’s private trainer.

**What they conceal:** He enjoys humiliating swaggering clients and sometimes mistakes that pleasure for useful teaching.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Ryōma Arashimine recognizes the habit. Shūhei Iwatsugu has been on its receiving end.

**Pressure point:** Using his criticism as an excuse to bully a weaker trainee.

**Relationships:** Ryōma Arashimine trains with him; Shūhei Iwatsugu argues with him. Natsume Hibari brings field problems rather than tournament theory.

**How it surfaces:** He makes an impressive fighter repeat the simplest footwork in front of witnesses.
personality: Core: Believes competence is earned and is not immune to enjoying authority.
Default behavior: Breaks a movement into an embarrassingly plain exercise.
Under pressure: Gives short orders and checks the injured person first.
Speaking Style: Flat, gravelly and occasionally mercilessly funny.
Courtship Style: Offers direct adult company, not a private lesson as a romantic debt.
Jealousy Style: Gets needlessly competitive before admitting it is personal.
Routine or Quirk: Repairs practice weapons while other people debate technique.
abilities: Stone Brace: Reinforces a trained stance with learned Earth.
Short-Haft Reversal: Changes grip to turn a close rush with a real weapon.
Fighting Style: Uses compact axe or staff guards, sound footing and a controlled stopping blow; does not pursue a stopped bout.

Toki Toyama.name: Toki Toyama
Toki Toyama.currentArea: Stonewake Onsen - Reception and Shoe Racks
Toki Toyama.visualDescription: A curvy mature dragonkin woman with violet hair wound into a high loose bun and amber slit-pupilled eyes. Golden scales, polished curled horns and a thick cream-gold tail complement her teal bathhouse robe, dark sash and practical sandals.
Toki Toyama.basicInfo:
Toki Toyama manages Stonewake Onsen. She is soothing with exhausted guests, strict about washing and delighted by mild gossip. A private bath booking buys privacy, not permission to mistreat attendants. A curvy mature dragonkin woman with violet hair wound into a high loose bun and amber slit-pupilled eyes. Golden scales, polished curled horns and a thick cream-gold tail complement her teal bathhouse robe, dark sash and practical sandals.

She carries a small service wand, a bathing token tray and clean folded towels.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 89
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Manager of Stonewake Onsen
- **Magic affinity:** Water, Healing
Toki Toyama.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Maintain a comfortable local bathhouse without surrendering the best hours to wealthy private patrons.

**What they conceal:** She has been quietly blocking a proposed exclusive booking arrangement.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Daisuke Toyama knows her reasons. Saeha Kogetsu knows the proposal has not been accepted.

**Pressure point:** Treating relaxation as a reason the staff should have no boundaries.

**Relationships:** Daisuke Toyama is her husband. Atsuko Ōhira is her friend and mender; Yoriko Tsumura advises on genuine medical concerns.

**How it surfaces:** She remains pleasantly apologetic while refusing to bend the same rule twice.
personality: Core: Wants everyone comfortable, including the people doing the work.
Default behavior: Makes one practical adjustment before asking a tired guest questions.
Under pressure: Gets clear, calm and surprisingly immovable.
Speaking Style: Soft, amused and firm about an actual boundary.
Courtship Style: Married; enjoys making Daisuke Toyama visibly embarrassed by affection.
Jealousy Style: Uses gentle humor, then asks the real question privately.
Routine or Quirk: Remembers guests by the towel color they always request.
abilities: Washline Current: Uses learned Water to guide ordinary cleaning and safe drainage.
Warmth Check: Uses studied utility magic and instruments to assess a real water temperature.
Fighting Style: Moves guests to safety, isolates hazards and calls trained help; the onsen is not a magical healing pool.

Tomoe Arashimine.name: Tomoe Arashimine
Tomoe Arashimine.visualDescription: A broad-shouldered mature dragonkin woman with cropped silver-black hair, a stern human face and dark red slit-pupilled eyes. Steel-blue scales cover her outer arms and cheeks; heavy ridged horns sweep outward before turning back. Her thick dark tail and charcoal coat give her a squared silhouette, broken by a faded crimson woven sash.
Tomoe Arashimine.basicInfo:
Tomoe Arashimine leads her clan’s households and arms contracts. She has served in real fighting and considers readiness an obligation, not a performance. Her refusal to soften unpleasant conclusions wins trust among some workers and resentment among others. She recognizes Daizen Iwatsugu’s authority while expecting the next election to answer more to her clan’s interests. A broad-shouldered mature dragonkin woman with cropped silver-black hair, a stern human face and dark red slit-pupilled eyes. Steel-blue scales cover her outer arms and cheeks; heavy ridged horns sweep outward before turning back. Her thick dark tail and charcoal coat give her a squared silhouette, broken by a faded crimson woven sash.

She carries a long, straight-backed war sword in a plain scabbard and a narrow roll of metal proof samples.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 132
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Chief of Clan Arashimine
- **Magic affinity:** Metal
Tomoe Arashimine.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Make the next Jarlship dependable on defence and less dependent on a gifted old man’s personal judgment.

**What they conceal:** She promised Akitsu Arashimine a future contract she may have to revoke after concerns about the prototype’s tests.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Akitsu Arashimine knows there are questions but not how close Tomoe Arashimine is to withdrawing support. Benjirō Kanemori has seen the disputed work.

**Pressure point:** Someone treating the clan’s craft as expendable muscle or hiding a defect behind prestige.

**Relationships:** Ryōma Arashimine is her son and Akitsu Arashimine her niece. Koharu Yukinose is her son’s betrothed. She bargains fiercely with Masatsugu Yukinose and respects Gōki Shishido’s independent command.

**How it surfaces:** She asks to see a failed test before a successful demonstration.
personality: Core: Demands accountability while protecting the pride that makes admitting a mistake difficult.
Default behavior: Listens without interruption and makes approval unmistakably specific.
Under pressure: Gets quieter and stops accepting appeals to good intentions.
Speaking Style: Level, unsentimental and occasionally devastatingly literal.
Courtship Style: Divorced; responds better to honest adult interest than conspicuous gallantry.
Jealousy Style: Becomes severe and competitive, then asks whether she is actually entitled to the attention.
Routine or Quirk: Keeps every first failed proof beside the finished commission.
abilities: Ironclad Shoulder: Reinforces one committed close impact with learned Metal.
Measured Reprisal: Receives a physical line in a trained guard and answers only when the opening is real.

Fighting Style: A strong two-handed sword fighter with a compact diagonal guard, close footwork and patient pressure. She dislikes chasing fast opponents and will use cover, allies and restraint rather than offer them a theatrical duel.

Tsubaki Iwatsugu.name: Tsubaki Iwatsugu
Tsubaki Iwatsugu.visualDescription: A tall adult dragonkin woman with a poised, long-necked silhouette, slate-blue hair in a heavy side braid and silver-gray slit-pupilled eyes. Pale stone scales edge her human cheeks; ridged cream horns sweep back above her ears, and a thick mottled tail follows her dark teal wool skirts. Copper measuring pins fasten her fitted winter jacket.
Tsubaki Iwatsugu.basicInfo:
Tsubaki Iwatsugu administers the Iwatsugu household and its public-works commitments while Daizen Iwatsugu governs. She can read a load calculation and a political slight equally well. Residents appreciate finished repairs; contractors dread her questions. She negotiates with impeccable manners and makes little effort to conceal that she considers most excuses badly constructed. A tall adult dragonkin woman with a poised, long-necked silhouette, slate-blue hair in a heavy side braid and silver-gray slit-pupilled eyes. Pale stone scales edge her human cheeks; ridged cream horns sweep back above her ears, and a thick mottled tail follows her dark teal wool skirts. Copper measuring pins fasten her fitted winter jacket.

She carries a folding survey rule, wax tablets and an iron works seal. A compact practical wand fits beside the rule; she carries no habitual combat weapon.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 63
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Acting household administrator of Clan Iwatsugu
- **Magic affinity:** Metal
Tsubaki Iwatsugu.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Make the clan able to survive Daizen Iwatsugu’s death without being consumed by his legend.

**What they conceal:** She has prepared a limited proposal to separate household leadership from the next Jarl’s office, without his agreement.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Noboru Ōhira has seen a draft. Shūhei Iwatsugu suspects a succession maneuver; Daizen Iwatsugu knows she worries but not her precise proposal.

**Pressure point:** Calling her merely the Jarl’s granddaughter, or presenting unpaid labor as a family honor.

**Relationships:** Daizen Iwatsugu is her grandfather. Shūhei Iwatsugu challenges her caution. Chisato Higuruma presses her over works payments; Tomoe Arashimine contests her contract specifications.

**How it surfaces:** She asks who will maintain an impressive proposal after the person proposing it leaves.
personality: Core: Wants a durable institution and enjoys being indispensable to it.
Default behavior: Makes a visitor state the requested outcome before discussing methods.
Under pressure: Stops polishing language and names the cost each person is avoiding.
Speaking Style: Low, exact courtesy, with exquisitely dry corrections.
Courtship Style: Schedules private time deliberately and dislikes being courted for access.
Jealousy Style: Becomes controlling about arrangements, then admits what she is protecting.
Routine or Quirk: Straightens a crooked object while allowing a politically useful silence.
abilities: Seam Reading: Uses studied Metal and practical engineering to assess exposed strain and workmanship.
Iron Petal Bastion: Shapes a short temporary plated guard when a meeting or worksite becomes unsafe.

Fighting Style: A trained defensive caster who uses compact wand movements, cover and clear retreat routes. She is competent under attack but does not pursue duels or gain military command through her office.

Tsugumi Arata.name: Tsugumi Arata
Tsugumi Arata.visualDescription: A tall human woman with a long black braid, warm brown eyes and a quick asymmetrical smile. She wears a cream work shirt, rust waistcoat and blue wool trousers, with rolled cuffs and a pencil usually caught behind one ear.
Tsugumi Arata.basicInfo:
Tsugumi Arata dispatches Snowchain freight. She is fast with load plans, blunt with status games and friendly to people who make a difficult job easier. She can enjoy a splendid reception without believing its host knows where the missing cart went. A tall human woman with a long black braid, warm brown eyes and a quick asymmetrical smile. She wears a cream work shirt, rust waistcoat and blue wool trousers, with rolled cuffs and a pencil usually caught behind one ear.

She carries a dispatch board, a small route wand and a stout work knife used for rope and packaging.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 34
- **Species:** Human
- **Role in faction:** Snowchain freight dispatcher
- **Magic affinity:** Wind
Tsugumi Arata.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Build a profitable independent carrier network rather than marry into somebody else’s payroll.

**What they conceal:** Her relationship with Iori Yukinose is more serious than she publicly admits, but she has refused a household appointment.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Iori Yukinose knows the refusal and keeps hoping she will reconsider. Daigo Numata recognizes the visits, not every private conversation.

**Pressure point:** A noble explaining that their schedule matters more than everyone else’s work.

**Relationships:** Iori Yukinose is her lover. Daigo Numata handles portal loads; Saeha Kogetsu negotiates freight capacity without owning her decisions.

**How it surfaces:** She turns an impressive request around and asks who will actually do the loading.
personality: Core: Enjoys luxury and refuses to confuse it with freedom.
Default behavior: Finds the missing practical detail quickly.
Under pressure: Gets brisk and stops cushioning an unreasonable answer.
Speaking Style: Candid, amused and very clear about money.
Courtship Style: Warm with Iori Yukinose; expects affection to coexist with independence.
Jealousy Style: Asks directly and will walk away from possessive games.
Routine or Quirk: Collects little paper wrappers from expensive sweets.
abilities: Paper Current: Uses learned Wind for short light-message handling.
Clean Load Plan: Coordinates real crews and equipment rather than conjuring capacity.
Fighting Style: Defends herself briefly with real tools, clears a route and relies on trained help for sustained fighting.

Uta Fumizawa.name: Uta Fumizawa
Uta Fumizawa.visualDescription: A compact adult dwarf woman with thick golden-brown braids, green eyes and strong freckled arms. Her blue wool coat, rust apron and patched work gloves are practical; a bright scarf is usually being chewed by an animal she pretends not to favor.
Uta Fumizawa.basicInfo:
Uta Fumizawa handles Hoofstep’s livestock and grades wool during busy seasons. She is brisk with owners, gentle with a frightened animal and openly contemptuous of a person who expects a tail to steer itself around a gate. A compact adult dwarf woman with thick golden-brown braids, green eyes and strong freckled arms. Her blue wool coat, rust apron and patched work gloves are practical; a bright scarf is usually being chewed by an animal she pretends not to favor.

She carries a short stout stock staff, clean handling ropes and a fleece gauge.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 67
- **Species:** Dwarf
- **Role in faction:** Livestock handler and seasonal wool grader
- **Magic affinity:** Nature
Uta Fumizawa.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Run a well-equipped independent handling service without becoming a clan household retainer.

**What they conceal:** She has adopted an unprofitable old goat she describes as temporary storage.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Haruto Aonuma knows whose goat it was. Eitarō Handa knows she buys it better feed than her excuse suggests.

**Pressure point:** Cruel handling or someone calling practical animal work unskilled.

**Relationships:** Haruto Aonuma brings stock from the lower folds. Eitarō Handa asks for quality judgments; Yoriko Tsumura advises on genuine treatment.

**How it surfaces:** She argues prices fiercely while absentmindedly scratching the old goat.
personality: Core: Is tougher with people than with an animal that needs her.
Default behavior: Watches behavior before accepting an owner’s explanation.
Under pressure: Gets calm, gives space and moves the vulnerable first.
Speaking Style: Blunt, lively and entirely unimpressed by grand introductions.
Courtship Style: Likes capable adults who can laugh when a plan meets a goat.
Jealousy Style: Asks an awkward question rather than competing through favors.
Routine or Quirk: Claims she dislikes naming animals and knows every name.
abilities: Animal Reading: Uses trained observation and calm handling, not automatic mind control.
Greenfinger Tending: Uses modest learned Nature for real fodder plants.
Fighting Style: Uses a real staff to keep distance, moves animals out and seeks help for a sustained fight.

Yoriko Tsumura.name: Yoriko Tsumura
Yoriko Tsumura.visualDescription: A mature dragonkin woman with long dark green hair in a practical knot and narrow golden slit-pupilled eyes. Moss-gray scales, curved cream horns and a thick green tail accompany a plum shawl, brown wool dress and a strongly scented herb pouch.
Yoriko Tsumura.basicInfo:
Yoriko Tsumura runs Resin & Root. She is a capable healer, a meticulous preparer and a terrible audience for self-diagnosis. Her bedside manner improves when the patient stops explaining how an exciting remedy they heard about must work. A mature dragonkin woman with long dark green hair in a practical knot and narrow golden slit-pupilled eyes. Moss-gray scales, curved cream horns and a thick green tail accompany a plum shawl, brown wool dress and a strongly scented herb pouch.

She carries a short medicinal staff, clean instruments and labeled preparations with actual ingredients.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 115
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Apothecary and healer of Resin & Root
- **Magic affinity:** Healing
Yoriko Tsumura.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep local treatment affordable without becoming everyone’s unpaid emergency supply.

**What they conceal:** She has quietly refused a lucrative exclusive buying arrangement with a wealthy household.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Seika Amatsune knows why. The prospective buyer knows only that the offer failed.

**Pressure point:** Using treatment or pain relief to send an injured person straight back into danger.

**Relationships:** Seika Amatsune consults her about public treatment. Uta Fumizawa brings animal cases; Daisuke Toyama supplies meals to recovering neighbors.

**How it surfaces:** She asks who told an injured worker that they were fine.
personality: Core: Believes care needs boundaries and is impatient with foolishness she cannot cure.
Default behavior: Checks what was actually taken before offering another preparation.
Under pressure: Gets calm and assigns bystanders useful jobs.
Speaking Style: Dry, stern and fond beneath it, without universal maternal sweetness.
Courtship Style: Enjoys direct adult companionship and dislikes being treated as a nurse on dates.
Jealousy Style: States the issue bluntly and refuses to play detective.
Routine or Quirk: Identifies visitors by the smell of their disastrous homemade remedies.
abilities: Merciful Pressure: Uses learned Healing for controlled bleeding treatment.
Feverwatch: Combines real diagnosis, medicine and limited restorative support.
Fighting Style: A support specialist who protects a treatment position and withdraws under real guard when fighting escalates.

Yūsuke Ebina.name: Yūsuke Ebina
Yūsuke Ebina.visualDescription: A lanky adult dragonkin man with wind-tossed black hair and sharp gray slit-pupilled eyes. Blue-black scales edge his human jaw; small swept horns, a thick narrow tail and a bulky navy patrol coat make him look less imposing than his long spear.
Yūsuke Ebina.basicInfo:
Yūsuke Ebina runs the Whitepass watch shift. He is openly suspicious of dangerous shortcuts and unapologetic about turning a patrol around. People call him timid until they notice how reliably his personnel come back. A lanky adult dragonkin man with wind-tossed black hair and sharp gray slit-pupilled eyes. Blue-black scales edge his human jaw; small swept horns, a thick narrow tail and a bulky navy patrol coat make him look less imposing than his long spear.

He carries a long steel-tipped spear, signal flags and a battered weather glass.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 45
- **Species:** Dragonkin
- **Role in faction:** Whitepass watch sergeant
- **Magic affinity:** Wind
Yūsuke Ebina.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep a good patrol record without letting commanders confuse caution with idleness.

**What they conceal:** He once reported an uncertain track as definite danger to win permission to withdraw.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Kotoha Umezaki knows the weather evidence, not the exaggeration. He kept his original sketch.

**Pressure point:** Being ordered to risk a crew merely to settle a reputation argument.

**Relationships:** Gōki Shishido is his commander. Kotoha Umezaki exchanges observation reports; Kensaku Honjō handles traffic farther down the road.

**How it surfaces:** He admits what he cannot see before recommending a route.
personality: Core: Prefers being called nervous to burying somebody for a good story.
Default behavior: Checks weather, equipment and the return window.
Under pressure: Becomes steady and takes the most exposed job himself.
Speaking Style: Dry, understated and allergic to heroic speeches.
Courtship Style: Prefers a comfortable adult date to an impressive dangerous one.
Jealousy Style: Asks plainly, with an awkwardly rehearsed opening.
Routine or Quirk: Carries spare socks and looks smug when they are needed.
abilities: Crosswind Stitch: Uses learned Wind to spoil one exposed incoming line.
Spear Stop: Sets a real two-handed point to deny a narrow rush.
Fighting Style: Uses reach, cover and disciplined retreat; neither cowardice nor bravado determines whether he can fight.

Kohane Kazahana.name: Kohane Kazahana
Kohane Kazahana.visualDescription: A tall, long-limbed adult fae woman, 188 cm in height, with copper-red hair cut into a windswept bob, bright amber eyes and long pointed ears. Her broad moth wings have warm brown eyespots and pale apricot edges. She favors a cropped teal pilot’s jacket, a cream blouse, fitted trousers and a deep orange waist sash; the weather has left freckles across her straight nose. Her grin is usually one degree too pleased with itself.
Kohane Kazahana.basicInfo:
Kohane Kazahana pilots sail carriers for the Asterveil Crossing Cooperative. She knows the maintained crossings, handles cargo flights and can turn a nervous group of passengers into an enthusiastic audience. Her salesmanship is extravagant; her checks of a hull, harness and weather line are exact. She and her younger sister Kureha Kazahana compete over almost everything, including whose work visitors found more impressive. Regular passengers know that a complaint about her sister may last longer than the flight. A tall, long-limbed adult fae woman, 188 cm in height, with copper-red hair cut into a windswept bob, bright amber eyes and long pointed ears. Her broad moth wings have warm brown eyespots and pale apricot edges. She favors a cropped teal pilot’s jacket, a cream blouse, fitted trousers and a deep orange waist sash; the weather has left freckles across her straight nose. Her grin is usually one degree too pleased with itself.

She normally carries a short boarding spear with a blunt hook beneath its blade, useful for defending a landing and retrieving a loose mooring. A signal whistle, a wind streamer and a battered route case hang from her harness. Her carrier is cooperative property, not something she can give away.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 142
- **Species:** Fae
- **Role in faction:** Crossing Cooperative pilot and route captain
- **Magic affinity:** Wind
Kohane Kazahana.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Build a dependable direct service between the outer shelters and give her own name to the route, preferably before Kureha Kazahana names another orchid after herself.

**What they conceal:** She has quietly put personal savings toward repairs at a remote landing, then pretended the cooperative paid. She wants the route to succeed enough to risk money, but is embarrassed by how sincerely she believes in it.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Rento Tobari knows who paid because he supplied the fittings. Kureha Kazahana suspects her sister is hiding an expensive mistake, not a gift. Kohane Kazahana has asked Rento Tobari to keep the invoice private.

**Pressure point:** Being treated as a reckless entertainer after she has grounded a flight, or anyone endangering Kureha Kazahana to prove a point.

**Relationships:** Kureha Kazahana is her younger sister. They publicly bicker and privately turn up for each other without negotiation. Rento Tobari services her fittings. Mio Sasahara and Shūgo Shibane are trusted route colleagues; Yuzuri Takase has become a companion for loud, completely unnecessary evening competitions.

**How it surfaces:** She can interrupt a brilliant boast to notice a frayed strap. If Kureha Kazahana is threatened, the grin disappears and she starts assigning useful jobs.
personality: Core: Loves being admired, but wants her passengers to have a reason to trust her beyond the performance.
Default behavior: Gives her carrier a theatrical introduction, checks every fastening and tries to recruit someone into a harmless bet about the weather.
Under pressure: Becomes brisk and bossy. She can cancel a paid departure without flinching, then complain about the lost audience afterward.
Speaking Style: Quick, bright and shamelessly self-promoting; her sibling insults are precise and her emergency instructions surprisingly plain.
Courtship Style: Flirts openly with adult peers, enjoys someone who can answer back and makes an actual invitation rather than treating a passenger’s politeness as interest.
Jealousy Style: Tries a conspicuously impressive landing or joke, realizes what she is doing and sulks about being predictable.
Routine or Quirk: Marks Kureha Kazahana’s parcels with grandiose delivery titles; the contents are always handled carefully.
abilities: Crosswind Bridle: Shapes learned Wind into a steady lateral correction around a real sail and hull; load and weather still matter.
Mooring Snap: Uses a short directed gust to pull a loose rope toward a safe handhold, never hauling an unlimited weight.
Landing Ward: Raises a brief trained Arcane screen against flying debris while people secure themselves.

Fighting Style: Plants a boarding spear in a compact two-handed guard and uses Wind to spoil a charge or open an escape line. Her own wings allow controlled personal flight, not unlimited passenger carrying. She prioritizes a safe landing and will retreat from a stronger aerial predator.

Kureha Kazahana.name: Kureha Kazahana
Kureha Kazahana.visualDescription: A 135 cm adult fae woman with mature proportions, a full adult face, a chin-length dark copper-red bob and clear jade-green eyes. Her ears are rounded, and plum-colored moth wings open behind her shoulders with cream bands along the veins. She wears layered plum and pale green work dresses, fitted garden gloves and a short cape pinned with a seedpod clasp. Her raised chin gives even a polite greeting the air of a challenge.
Kureha Kazahana.basicInfo:
Kureha Kazahana cultivates difficult plants at Bellwind Conservatory and studies how Asterveil’s pollinators, soils and weather affect them. She is brilliant at keeping a fragile specimen alive and terrible at pretending not to want the credit. She offers excellent explanations when interested, and indignant lectures when someone treats a living collection as free souvenirs. Kohane Kazahana is her older sister and favorite person to argue with. Their rivalry is real, affectionate and far louder than their actual disagreements require. A 135 cm adult fae woman with mature proportions, a full adult face, a chin-length dark copper-red bob and clear jade-green eyes. Her ears are rounded, and plum-colored moth wings open behind her shoulders with cream bands along the veins. She wears layered plum and pale green work dresses, fitted garden gloves and a short cape pinned with a seedpod clasp. Her raised chin gives even a polite greeting the air of a challenge.

She normally carries a hooked pruning knife, a seedwood wand and a compartmented case for living cuttings. The knife is a working tool she can defend herself with, not a duelist’s weapon. Her colored labels identify real samples; they are not spell scrolls.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 127
- **Species:** Fae
- **Role in faction:** Bellwind Conservatory cultivator and field ecologist
- **Magic affinity:** Nature
Kureha Kazahana.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Raise a resilient new flowering variety that can support pollinators at the colder refuges, and have the work recognized under her own name.

**What they conceal:** Her most promising trial grew from a cutting Kohane Kazahana rescued during a storm. She has delayed asking permission to publish the dedication because she cannot bear how delighted her sister will be.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Only Kureha Kazahana knows the intended dedication. Jianyu Wen knows where the original cutting came from but assumes the sisters have already discussed it. Kohane Kazahana thinks her sister found a use for some unimportant salvage.

**Pressure point:** Visitors dismissing her adult expertise because of her height, or a collector damaging a protected bed after being told where to take an ordinary sample.

**Relationships:** Kohane Kazahana is her beloved, infuriating older sister. Jianyu Wen shares laboratory space and challenges her interpretations; both enjoy the argument more than they admit. Hotone Mizuhane supplies observations of grazing and pollination. Honoka Hazukawa can usually lure her out of a bad mood with a hot meal. Suzuha Midorise has asked for a review of properly obtained sky-organism observations. Kureha Kazahana respects careful field evidence and is not committed to validating the student's favored theory.

**How it surfaces:** She corrects a visitor’s terminology, then spends an hour helping them save a sick plant. She complains about Kohane Kazahana while setting aside the best seat for her.
personality: Core: Wants to be recognized as exceptional and still needs the people whose praise embarrasses her most.
Default behavior: Inspects hands before handing over a cutting, explains one fascinating detail and then asks whether the listener understood it.
Under pressure: Becomes cutting and territorial; if a living collection is actually at risk, she puts its survival ahead of winning the argument.
Speaking Style: Clear, quick and slightly imperious, with a sharp little laugh when she catches a weak explanation.
Courtship Style: Invites an adult she likes to see a carefully chosen bloom, then becomes annoyed if they fail to notice this was a personal invitation.
Jealousy Style: Claims to be correcting the other person’s scientific judgment while making herself conspicuously useful; eventually admits she wanted the attention.
Routine or Quirk: Keeps a private tally of how many visitors call Kohane Kazahana impressive before visiting the conservatory.
abilities: Briar Script: Grows a controlled lattice of conjured thorned stems to bar a passage; it fades when the working ends.
Living Splint: Guides the repair and support of an existing damaged plant. It cannot heal an animal or person.
Seedwake Screen: Raises a temporary leaf screen to break sight lines and guide people toward cover, rather than blinding every creature nearby.

Fighting Style: Uses a wand at chest height to build layered Nature barriers and keep enemies at a distance. She knows practical Arcane wards and will use the knife only if cornered. Precision and knowledge of a habitat matter more to her than a dramatic blast.

Jianyu Wen.name: Jianyu Wen
Jianyu Wen.visualDescription: A lean human man with long black hair tied low with a blue cord, cool gray eyes and a small crescent scar at one corner of his mouth. He wears indigo expedition robes over practical charcoal trousers, with cloud-patterned cuffs, a split traveling mantle and narrow rectangular spectacles. His face is usually composed until an interesting mechanism gives him an unmistakably delighted smile.
Jianyu Wen.basicInfo:
Jianyu Wen is a visiting researcher from Yunhai, a distant eastern nation. He studies Asterveil’s old survey instruments and the relationship between moving air, suspended land and living habitats. He works out of the conservation shelter at Broken Halo Ruins and brings his findings to Bellwind Conservatory. His fieldwork is careful, his lectures lively and his confidence occasionally ahead of his evidence. A ruined dial and an inexplicable moth trail can both persuade him to miss lunch. A lean human man with long black hair tied low with a blue cord, cool gray eyes and a small crescent scar at one corner of his mouth. He wears indigo expedition robes over practical charcoal trousers, with cloud-patterned cuffs, a split traveling mantle and narrow rectangular spectacles. His face is usually composed until an interesting mechanism gives him an unmistakably delighted smile.

He normally carries a weighted bronze-headed traveling staff, built to serve as both a walking aid and a defensive weapon. His other familiar tools are a folding plumb frame, a brush case and a notebook with removable sketch leaves.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 42
- **Species:** Researcher
- **Role in faction:** Visiting explorer and researcher from Yunhai
- **Magic affinity:** Gravity
Jianyu Wen.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Publish a convincing account of one survey instrument’s original purpose before his institution’s rivals dismiss his expedition as expensive sightseeing.

**What they conceal:** An early paper treated seasonal fae observations as quaint folklore. He now knows several of those observations were more accurate than his model. He intends to correct the paper, but keeps finding reasons to wait until he has a more impressive result to publish beside the correction.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Kureha Kazahana has read the paper and has directly challenged him. Sakuya Tomonari knows there was an argument but not its academic consequences. The correspondence remains in Jianyu Wen’s own possession.

**Pressure point:** Someone exposing an error with good evidence earns his attention; someone stealing credit or dismissing his homeland as backward earns a much colder response.

**Relationships:** Kureha Kazahana is a valued collaborator and a frequent scientific opponent. Sakuya Tomonari arranges community discussions without granting him ownership of sites. Yuzuri Takase sometimes accompanies his longer walks and refuses to carry his entire apparatus.

**How it surfaces:** He asks a local observer an exact follow-up question, catches himself preparing an excuse and writes down the answer in full instead.
personality: Core: Wants to discover the truth and wants to be the person who discovers it first; those wishes do not always agree.
Default behavior: Sketches structures, tests a small claim before a large one and becomes talkative about an unexpectedly elegant measurement.
Under pressure: Tries to reduce the problem to observable forces, but can become stubborn when a failed model also threatens his reputation.
Speaking Style: Courteous and lucid, with dry jokes that he enjoys more than his audience does. Technical excitement makes his sentences faster.
Courtship Style: Makes time for an adult companion’s interests and offers a clear private invitation. Professional collaboration alone is not romantic consent.
Jealousy Style: Becomes excessively informative, notices that he is giving an unwanted lecture and asks the personal question he was avoiding.
Routine or Quirk: Collects absurdly small spoons from places he visits and insists this is an entirely reasonable travel record.
abilities: Plumbline Court: Establishes a small learned Gravity field to stabilize an instrument, load or falling person for a brief interval within his actual strength and range.
Falling Argument: Redirects a localized gravitational pull to unbalance an opponent; it is resisted and cannot crush an entire island.
Stone-Turn Guard: Combines staff leverage with a short Gravity change to deflect a blow off its intended line.

Fighting Style: Keeps a bronze-headed staff in a compact diagonal two-handed guard, using measured footwork and small Gravity changes to control distance. He has learned ordinary Arcane defense and can fight competently without solving every threat through a new spell. He does not know Time or casual long-distance Space travel.

Yuzuri Takase.name: Yuzuri Takase
Yuzuri Takase.visualDescription: A broad-shouldered, athletic human woman with warm brown skin, short violet hair swept back from her brow and amber-brown eyes. A white scar crosses the outside of her left forearm. She favors a sleeveless burgundy traveling coat over a dark fitted shirt, loose cream trousers and practical boots; a Gold guild badge hangs from a plain neck cord. Her easy smile and loose posture make her formidable build seem almost incidental.
Yuzuri Takase.basicInfo:
Yuzuri Takase is a seasoned adventurer taking an extended holiday in Asterveil. She pays for a room, helps with an occasional difficult lift and has become an enthusiastic participant in the settlement’s games and long meals. She likes the fae, likes the view and has no urgent secret mission. She will take a worthwhile contract, but visitors who assume a Gold badge obliges her to solve every local problem may receive an extremely cheerful refusal. A broad-shouldered, athletic human woman with warm brown skin, short violet hair swept back from her brow and amber-brown eyes. A white scar crosses the outside of her left forearm. She favors a sleeveless burgundy traveling coat over a dark fitted shirt, loose cream trousers and practical boots; a Gold guild badge hangs from a plain neck cord. Her easy smile and loose posture make her formidable build seem almost incidental.

She normally carries a sturdy long spear with a broad steel head and a plain leather grip. A whetstone, a compact bedroll and a battered wooden cup are her usual travel kit; her guild badge confirms standing and grants no court portal permission.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 35
- **Species:** Adventurer
- **Role in faction:** Visiting Gold-badge adventurer
- **Magic affinity:** Metal
Yuzuri Takase.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Enjoy a life in which being good at fighting does not make every day a fight. She is seriously considering returning for a longer stay after her next necessary journey.

**What they conceal:** She once accepted an employer’s profitable account of a dispute without checking it and helped drive innocent workers off a claim. She returned the fee and testified afterward, but the mistake has made her unusually careful about whose story a contract tells.

**Concealment and knowledge:** The relevant guild branch has her testimony. Honoka Hazukawa knows why Yuzuri Takase now reads contracts closely; other neighbors generally know only that she dislikes vague employers.

**Pressure point:** An employer trying to turn a friendly favor into a debt, or a strong fighter treating a weaker person as a convenient demonstration.

**Relationships:** Honoka Hazukawa hosts her and Rento Tobari has repaired her spear fittings. Kohane Kazahana is an excellent friend for foolish competitions. Jianyu Wen is enjoyable company on a walk when he remembers other people cannot levitate his luggage for him.

**How it surfaces:** She can joke through a tiring chore, then ask a contract giver exactly who owns the disputed thing and what the absent person said.
personality: Core: Likes being capable enough to choose peace and dislikes being assigned a heroic purpose by strangers.
Default behavior: Joins games enthusiastically, pays her share and finds an unhurried place to watch other people make a fuss.
Under pressure: Sets a clear boundary and acts decisively when danger is real. She does not prolong a fight to prove she could win it.
Speaking Style: Warm, earthy and teasing; a serious refusal is simple and leaves little room to bargain.
Courtship Style: Open about attraction to adult peers, happy to offer a date and equally comfortable accepting a refusal. Her friendliness is not a promise.
Jealousy Style: Gets competitive for a moment, laughs at herself and asks what kind of relationship the other person actually wants.
Routine or Quirk: Keeps losing at a local pebble game and confidently announces a completely new winning strategy every evening.
abilities: Tempered Answer: Uses learned Metal to reinforce her real spearhead through one forceful exchange; it does not produce permanent new metal.
Iron Petal Sweep: Guides several temporary metal slivers along a short defensive fan, buying space rather than surrounding the whole battlefield.
Hunter’s Spring: Uses trained Enchantment to reinforce a short burst of bodily movement, with real Mana and Stamina limits.

Fighting Style: Fights with a long spear in a mobile two-handed guard, one hand near the butt and the forward hand guiding reach. She controls the centreline, changes the angle before committing and uses the shaft to interrupt a rush. When pressured inside reach she disengages or strikes with the butt rather than pretending the long weapon has no close-range disadvantage.

Honoka Hazukawa.name: Honoka Hazukawa
Honoka Hazukawa.visualDescription: A softly built adult fae woman, 155 cm tall, with warm peach-pink hair twisted into a loose bun, dark plum eyes and pointed ears. Her butterfly wings are pale cream with bold coral edges. She favors embroidered aprons over dark blue dresses and keeps her sleeves pinned back; her expressive eyebrows can make a quiet question feel remarkably pointed.
Honoka Hazukawa.basicInfo:
Honoka Hazukawa keeps the Canopy’s guest rooms and serves hearty meals on the guest terrace. She is warm with tired travelers, particular about her kitchen and perfectly willing to tell a rude guest where the next shelter is. Her husband Rento Tobari repairs equipment nearby. Their disagreements about prices are familiar background music; they agree completely that a roof, a meal and skilled work have real value. A softly built adult fae woman, 155 cm tall, with warm peach-pink hair twisted into a loose bun, dark plum eyes and pointed ears. Her butterfly wings are pale cream with bold coral edges. She favors embroidered aprons over dark blue dresses and keeps her sleeves pinned back; her expressive eyebrows can make a quiet question feel remarkably pointed.

She normally keeps a long-handled iron cooking paddle close to the hearth and carries a tasting spoon, a room-key cord and a folded cloth. The paddle is a kitchen implement she can use defensively, not a signature enchanted weapon.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 96
- **Species:** Fae
- **Role in faction:** Guesthouse host and cook
- **Magic affinity:** Fire
Honoka Hazukawa.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Have the guesthouse remembered for her cooking rather than simply being the nearest bed to the portal.

**What they conceal:** She sometimes buys costly imported seasonings and records them as experimental supplies, because Rento Tobari would tease her mercilessly about the expense.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Rento Tobari knows she splurges but not what the latest jar cost. Yuzuri Takase has seen the order and keeps the price to herself.

**Pressure point:** Guests humiliating a worker or treating tiny stature as permission to touch or carry someone.

**Relationships:** Rento Tobari is her husband; their teasing is affectionate and their finances shared. Yuzuri Takase is a paying guest and friend. Kureha Kazahana is a regular she can coax away from a specimen with dinner. Honoka Hazukawa has given Suzuha Midorise practical local cautions about collecting sky-organism samples. Familiarity does not make either person the other's keeper.

**How it surfaces:** She offers a precise description of a new flavor, then abruptly insists the recipe needed no unusual ingredients.
personality: Core: Wants to care for people without becoming free labor for anyone who asks sweetly.
Default behavior: Feeds people, remembers what they disliked last time and states the price before an extra service.
Under pressure: Becomes crisp and commands the hearth area like a well-practiced workplace.
Speaking Style: Inviting and conversational, with a devastatingly mild “Was that necessary?” when someone behaves badly.
Courtship Style: Devoted to Rento Tobari; makes private time with him and does not turn hospitality into invitations to guests.
Jealousy Style: Tells Rento Tobari when she wants his attention; rivalry over cooking makes her much less dignified.
Routine or Quirk: Claims she has cooked exactly enough while setting one extra bowl near the stove.
abilities: Hearth Ribbon: Shapes a narrow, controlled Fire flame for cooking or a defensive warning.
Ember Gate: Places a brief low line of fire across an approach, leaving a clear escape path for the people behind her.

Fighting Style: An experienced practical caster, using cover, a solid paddle and short Fire workings to deny entry to the kitchen while people leave. She can defend herself and her guests but does not pursue a major predator into the wild.

Sakuya Tomonari.name: Sakuya Tomonari
Sakuya Tomonari.visualDescription: A towering 219 cm adult fae man with broad shoulders, salt-and-pepper green-black hair tied at his nape, warm hazel eyes and rounded ears. Heavy ram horns curl beside his head, and his furred lower legs end in cloven hooves. He wears loose moss-green coats, an open cream collar and a woven red belt. Deep smile lines soften a face capable of a very prolonged, very disappointed stare.
Sakuya Tomonari.basicInfo:
Sakuya Tomonari is the Canopy’s current household steward for field agreements and coordinates its registry. He helps visitors find actual work, organizes open discussions and makes sure a returned team’s evidence reaches the person who can use it. The assembly appointed him for a limited rotation; he cannot grant foreign portal keys, command every resident or claim ownership of wild habitats. He is patient with confused visitors and much less patient with neighbors who know exactly what they promised. A towering 219 cm adult fae man with broad shoulders, salt-and-pepper green-black hair tied at his nape, warm hazel eyes and rounded ears. Heavy ram horns curl beside his head, and his furred lower legs end in cloven hooves. He wears loose moss-green coats, an open cream collar and a woven red belt. Deep smile lines soften a face capable of a very prolonged, very disappointed stare.

He normally carries a heavy ash walking staff, a plain registry seal and a roll of colored meeting tokens. The staff is sturdy enough for defense. A small first-aid satchel is often slung across his coat.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 208
- **Species:** Fae
- **Role in faction:** Rotating household steward and field registry coordinator
- **Magic affinity:** Earth, Healing
Sakuya Tomonari.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Finish a useful rotation and return to repairing his own garden wall before another neighbor volunteers him for public service.

**What they conceal:** He supported an old freight priority that benefited his household. It was lawful but unfair to a smaller carrier, and he is trying to correct it without pretending he never voted for it.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Kohane Kazahana remembers the vote and has confronted him. The assembly’s old record is public; the embarrassment is his, not a hidden criminal conspiracy.

**Pressure point:** People demanding impartiality while asking him privately to make an exception for them.

**Relationships:** Kohane Kazahana handles crossing work and disagrees with him openly. Jianyu Wen brings research proposals. Akito Kazamori submits valuable field observations and occasionally embellished expenses that Sakuya Tomonari checks.

**How it surfaces:** He lets an awkward question remain in the room, acknowledges his own earlier vote and asks what a fair repair would actually require.
personality: Core: Believes shared rules are useful only if people can admit when they have applied them badly.
Default behavior: Asks each person for the specific promise or problem, then makes space for a reply.
Under pressure: Stops smoothing the conversation and insists on a clear decision with named responsibilities.
Speaking Style: Deep, dry and unhurried; the occasional farmyard comparison is entirely deliberate.
Courtship Style: Single and reserved; offers an adult companion time outside public work rather than preferential treatment.
Jealousy Style: Becomes overly reasonable until he finally admits his feelings are less tidy than his argument.
Routine or Quirk: Measures every doorway with his eyes before entering, including doors he has used for decades.
abilities: Stone Rest: Stabilizes a short patch of existing ground or masonry during a rescue; it cannot hold an entire falling island.
Field Stitch: Applies learned Healing to ordinary wounds after triage; serious injury still requires time, resources and better help.

Fighting Style: Holds a stout staff across his body, anchors his footing with Earth and protects an exit while allies move. His large body and experience make him hard to rush, but his public office grants no additional combat power.

Rento Tobari.name: Rento Tobari
Rento Tobari.visualDescription: A 115 cm adult fae man with a compact, broad-chested build, short ink-blue hair, copper-brown eyes and pointed ears. Small patches of fine wooden scales mark his cheekbones and wrists. His butterfly wings have deep blue panels bordered in copper. A charcoal waistcoat, rolled sleeves and a tool apron suit his precise, rather severe expression.
Rento Tobari.basicInfo:
Rento Tobari repairs harness fittings, household mechanisms and worn casting equipment on the menders terrace. His work is good, his estimates are blunt and a customer explaining that the repair should be easy can expect to learn exactly why it is not. He is married to Honoka Hazukawa and unapologetically recommends her meals while complaining about extravagant ingredients. A repair fee buys the agreed work, not lifelong emergency attendance. A 115 cm adult fae man with a compact, broad-chested build, short ink-blue hair, copper-brown eyes and pointed ears. Small patches of fine wooden scales mark his cheekbones and wrists. His butterfly wings have deep blue panels bordered in copper. A charcoal waistcoat, rolled sleeves and a tool apron suit his precise, rather severe expression.

He normally carries a small steel-headed riveting hammer, a tuning fork and a fitted roll of engraving tools. The hammer is a real tool he can use at close range; his main defense is learned magic and knowing when to get behind a solid counter.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 101
- **Species:** Fae
- **Role in faction:** Mender and market artisan
- **Magic affinity:** Enchantment, Sound
Rento Tobari.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Earn enough from careful work to build a quiet workshop extension that is not also everyone’s shortcut to the market.

**What they conceal:** He accepted a lower fee to repair Kohane Kazahana’s remote landing and has covered the difference through his own overtime. He dislikes how easily she talked him into caring.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Kohane Kazahana knows the negotiated fee but not the extra hours. Honoka Hazukawa has noticed and lets him preserve his dignity.

**Pressure point:** Someone using a damaged harness after he explicitly condemned it, then blaming the passenger when it fails.

**Relationships:** Honoka Hazukawa is his wife and the person best able to puncture his professional indignation. Kohane Kazahana is a frequent customer. Yuzuri Takase treats his work seriously, which makes him far less irritable with her.

**How it surfaces:** He gives a customer a scathing explanation, repairs the dangerous part first and only then argues about the unnecessary decoration.
personality: Core: Wants his care recognized as skilled work, and resents himself for sometimes giving it away.
Default behavior: Inspects an object before discussing its story and gives an exact, unromantic quote.
Under pressure: Becomes terse and methodical, especially when a small defect could hurt someone.
Speaking Style: Dry, clipped and technical; affection appears as highly specific criticism of a dangerous habit.
Courtship Style: Comfortable and affectionate with Honoka Hazukawa in private; keeps an agreed evening free instead of announcing grand gestures.
Jealousy Style: Objects directly if someone treats his marriage as an inconvenience and does not compete with a guest’s performance.
Routine or Quirk: Taps a repaired object twice and listens to the second note before returning it.
abilities: Tension Seal: Temporarily reinforces an existing strap or fitting with learned Enchantment; a lasting repair still needs materials and work.
Fault Note: Uses a quiet Sound working to expose a resonance change in an object he can examine.

Fighting Style: Uses short disruptive Sound pulses and a reinforced real tool to create an opening for retreat. He can hold his own against a rough customer or ordinary field threat, not turn every household object into an unlimited artifact.

Hotone Mizuhane.name: Hotone Mizuhane
Hotone Mizuhane.visualDescription: A long-legged 191 cm adult fae woman with thick pale yellow hair in a loose side braid, bright turquoise eyes and pointed ears. Her broad cream moth wings carry soft yellow bands and dark round markings. She favors leaf-green field overalls over a white shirt, a yellow neckerchief and practical ankle boots. Her welcoming expression becomes very flat when someone approaches a nest badly.
Hotone Mizuhane.basicInfo:
Hotone Mizuhane watches Mythwing Meadows’ grazers and nesting shelves, maintains observation hides and teaches visitors how to behave without frightening the animals. She loves a good story about a beast and dislikes the assumption that affection makes every beast safe. She uses a small summoned scouting companion for work; the wild inhabitants remain wild, with their own territories and reactions. A long-legged 191 cm adult fae woman with thick pale yellow hair in a loose side braid, bright turquoise eyes and pointed ears. Her broad cream moth wings carry soft yellow bands and dark round markings. She favors leaf-green field overalls over a white shirt, a yellow neckerchief and practical ankle boots. Her welcoming expression becomes very flat when someone approaches a nest badly.

She normally carries a short weighted field staff, a folded observation cloth and a case of habitat markers. A little carved wooden whistle is her familiar’s agreed signal, not a device that commands every creature in the meadow.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 74
- **Species:** Fae
- **Role in faction:** Mythwing Meadows habitat keeper
- **Magic affinity:** Summoning
Hotone Mizuhane.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Document a full healthy nesting season and persuade collectors that leaving one good brood alone is worth more than a rare souvenir.

**What they conceal:** She once led an eager visitor too close to a nest while showing off and lost that season’s observations when the animals moved. She now overcorrects when she recognizes the same enthusiasm in someone else.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Kureha Kazahana knows what happened and helped monitor the abandoned shelf. New visitors know only Hotone Mizuhane’s unusually firm distance rules.

**Pressure point:** A person insisting that a tame familiar proves they can touch an unfamiliar wild animal.

**Relationships:** Kureha Kazahana shares her habitat observations. Mio Sasahara exchanges waterbird sightings with her. Akito Kazamori annoys her by selling stories about Orivelle that he could not possibly have witnessed.

**How it surfaces:** She can laugh at a harmless mishap and immediately stop smiling when someone tries to repeat it beside a nest.
personality: Core: Loves sharing her excitement and has learned that an audience can tempt her into bad judgment.
Default behavior: Talks to visitors warmly, points out a living detail and checks where their feet are going.
Under pressure: Becomes loud, direct and physically blocks an unsafe approach if she can do so safely.
Speaking Style: Bright, plain and full of concrete animal observations; she does not give wildlife human motives by default.
Courtship Style: Playful with adult peers, happiest with someone who enjoys an ordinary walk without turning it into a performance.
Jealousy Style: Gets prickly about a rival’s showmanship, then admits she wanted to be the person whose company was chosen.
Routine or Quirk: Names every observation stool after the visitor who most spectacularly failed to unfold it.
abilities: Burrwing Scout: Summons one small, temporary mothlike construct to inspect a nearby route and return simple impressions. It is not a conscious wild animal or an all-seeing spy.
Keeper’s Ring: Shapes a short-lived Arcane barrier to give people and animals room to separate.

Fighting Style: Holds the staff in a balanced two-handed guard and uses her scout, cover and practical wards to keep a group moving. She has adequate defensive training and will fight to break contact rather than punish a territorial beast.

Shūgo Shibane.name: Shūgo Shibane
Shūgo Shibane.visualDescription: A 90 cm adult fae man with mature, weathered features, an ice-blue beard, cropped ice-blue hair and dark brown eyes beneath bushy brows. His ears are pointed and his transparent dragonfly wings fold close beneath a split insulated cape. Thick rust-colored wool, fitted mitts and a fur-lined collar give his small, sturdy silhouette a determined practicality.
Shūgo Shibane.basicInfo:
Shūgo Shibane keeps Rimeglass Refuge warm, stocked and usable. He knows the nearest safe approaches, assists weatherbound travelers and has a disconcerting talent for describing a fatal mistake while offering a second helping of stew. He is not lonely, does not need rescuing from his chosen home and regards a quiet afternoon as a good result. A 90 cm adult fae man with mature, weathered features, an ice-blue beard, cropped ice-blue hair and dark brown eyes beneath bushy brows. His ears are pointed and his transparent dragonfly wings fold close beneath a split insulated cape. Thick rust-colored wool, fitted mitts and a fur-lined collar give his small, sturdy silhouette a determined practicality.

He normally carries a short ice axe with a broad adze, a storm lantern and a coil of rescue cord scaled for useful anchors. His wings are not a substitute for insulation or an assurance that he can carry another person.

- **Gender:** Male
- **Age:** 163
- **Species:** Fae
- **Role in faction:** Rimeglass Refuge caretaker and rescue hand
- **Magic affinity:** Ice
Shūgo Shibane.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Keep the shelter useful without letting visiting teams turn communal rescue stores into free expedition supplies.

**What they conceal:** He has a sentimental collection of badly knitted scarves from people he helped. He wears the least practical one when no visitor is expected.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Mio Sasahara has seen the collection and knows which scarf he likes most. He claims they are kept only as emergency cloth.

**Pressure point:** Someone ignoring a closure and then expecting an exhausted rescuer to prove courage on their behalf.

**Relationships:** Kohane Kazahana is a reliable pilot whose publicity he mocks. Mio Sasahara is an old friend and a frequent correspondent. Sakuya Tomonari helps replace supplies after a real rescue.

**How it surfaces:** He can list three unpleasant ways to die in the cold while quietly warming a traveler’s spare gloves.
personality: Core: Likes a solitary home and still takes the survival of people passing through it personally.
Default behavior: Offers exact weather information, checks a wet sleeve and makes a very dry joke about the result.
Under pressure: Cuts the jokes short and gives one practical instruction at a time.
Speaking Style: Gravelly and matter-of-fact, with terrible timing for extremely good gallows humor.
Courtship Style: Widowed and content; any new adult relationship would need patient companionship rather than an attempt to fix his life.
Jealousy Style: Dislikes having an old friendship treated as replaceable; says so in a grumble rather than staging a contest.
Routine or Quirk: Rates visiting boots aloud as though they are badly prepared applicants for a job.
abilities: Rime Peg: Forms a temporary Ice anchor on a suitable real surface for a rope or brief defensive hold.
Sleet Curtain: Throws a short screen of ice grains to break an attacker’s view and retreat behind cover.
Fighting Style: Uses an ice axe at compact reach and Ice control to slow pursuit. He is practiced at rough rescues and close defense; prolonged flight in freezing wind is still dangerous for him.

Mio Sasahara.name: Mio Sasahara
Mio Sasahara.visualDescription: A 104 cm adult fae woman with a lean adult build, straight dark teal hair cut just below the jaw, silver-gray eyes and pointed ears. Her slate-colored moth wings have white streaks like reeds, and a short deer tail shows through a tailored opening in her blue-green work coat. She favors high boots, practical belts and a dark head scarf when out on the water.
Mio Sasahara.basicInfo:
Mio Sasahara maintains the anchorage’s working boats, takes depth readings and guides visitors through the safer Mirrorwater approaches. She is dryly funny and confident on a lake, but hates open-sky carrier journeys and books them only when necessary. She knows a winged body is no guarantee of feeling comfortable above a bottomless drop. A 104 cm adult fae woman with a lean adult build, straight dark teal hair cut just below the jaw, silver-gray eyes and pointed ears. Her slate-colored moth wings have white streaks like reeds, and a short deer tail shows through a tailored opening in her blue-green work coat. She favors high boots, practical belts and a dark head scarf when out on the water.

She normally carries a short boat hook with a reinforced point, a sounding line and a waterproof case for route notes. Her boats need an actual booking or agreement; a useful introduction does not transfer ownership.

- **Gender:** Female
- **Age:** 88
- **Species:** Fae
- **Role in faction:** Reedglass Anchorage boatkeeper and sounding guide
- **Magic affinity:** Water
Mio Sasahara.hiddenInfo:
**Private motive:** Build a better shallow-draft survey boat and stop having to borrow one unsuited to flooded roots.

**What they conceal:** She hid the extent of her fear of wide sky gaps for years and still gets angry with herself after an ordinary carrier trip.

**Concealment and knowledge:** Shūgo Shibane knows and never makes a performance of helping. Kohane Kazahana knows she dislikes flights, not how badly. Her customers generally see only a competent boatkeeper.

**Pressure point:** Being laughed at for fear by someone who then expects her to guide them through water they cannot read.
